In 1667 the Jesuit Claude Allouez travelled up the river with Indigenous guides to visit Nipissing people who had taken refuge at the lake after the wars of 1649–50. He celebrated Mass beside the river before continuing to their village.

French traders later established posts in the Nipigon country to obtain furs and compete with the English on Hudson Bay. One post stood near the northern end of Lake Nipigon, while the river connected the lake to Superior and the canoe routes of the Great Lakes. The North West Company maintained a post at the river mouth in the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries, before its union with the Hudson's Bay Company in 1821.
simp_chinese:
尼皮贡河从广阔的内陆湖泊向南流入苏必利尔湖，穿过奥吉布瓦人的森林地区。1667年，耶稣会士克洛德·阿卢埃在原住民向导陪同下溯河而上，探访1649至1650年战争后在湖区避难的尼皮辛人。他在河边举行弥撒，然后继续前往他们的村落。

后来法国商人在尼皮贡地区建立贸易站，收购毛皮，与哈得孙湾的英国人竞争。湖的北端附近设有商站，而尼皮贡河将湖泊与苏必利尔湖及五大湖独木舟路线连接起来。十八世纪末至十九世纪初，西北公司在河口维持商站；1821年，它与哈得孙湾公司合并。

english:
The Nipissing, or Nbisiing Anishinaabeg, lived around the lake that bears their name and in the forests to its north, west and south. Hunting and fishing sustained communities in a country of interlinked lakes and rivers. Their position on the route between the Ottawa valley and Georgian Bay also made them important intermediaries among Algonquian peoples, the Huron and French traders.

In the early seventeenth century the trader Jean Nicolet lived among the Nipissing and learned from visitors who came to the lake to exchange goods. Warfare later drove some of the people away from the lake; a Nipissing village was recorded at Lake Nipigon during the upheavals of 1649–50. Some returned to their homeland later in the century and resumed their life and trade around Lake Nipissing.
simp_chinese:
尼皮辛人自称恩比辛阿尼希纳贝人，生活在同名湖泊周围以及湖的北、西、南三面的森林中。狩猎和捕鱼养活着这里的社群，湖泊与河流彼此相连。他们居于渥太华河谷通往乔治亚湾的路线上，也因此成为阿尔冈昆语族人群、休伦人与法国商人之间的重要中介。

十七世纪初，商人让·尼科莱曾与尼皮辛人共同生活，向来湖边交换货物的访客了解各地情形。后来战争迫使部分居民离开湖区；1649至1650年的动荡中，有记载称尼皮辛人在尼皮贡湖建立了村落。该世纪晚些时候，一部分人返回故土，在尼皮辛湖一带恢复生活和贸易。

english: The Nipissis is a tributary of the Moisie, whose waters reach the north shore of the St Lawrence. Its name is thought to come from an Innu word for a small stream or body of water. Innu families used the Moisie and its tributaries to travel between the coast and hunting grounds far inland, ascending in autumn and returning in spring. The Nipissis offered one of the alternative routes through this extensive river country.
simp_chinese: 尼皮西斯河是莫瓦西河的支流，河水最终抵达圣劳伦斯河北岸。河名可能源自因努语中表示小河或小水域的词。因努家庭利用莫瓦西河及其支流往来海岸与遥远的内陆猎场，秋天溯流而上，春天再返回。尼皮西斯河是这片广大河流地区中可供选择的一条道路。

sources.title: bilan ecologique et historique de la pointe de moisie.pdf

english: Lake Nipisso lies in the wooded country north of the St Lawrence, where the river of the same name widens before joining the Nipissis. Its name is related to an Innu word for a small body of water or stream. Innu families travelled the Moisie basin between coastal gathering places and their inland hunting territories; Lake Nipisso was among the waters associated with those journeys. After winter in the interior, families returned towards the coast in spring.
simp_chinese: 尼皮索湖位于圣劳伦斯河北面的森林中，同名河流在汇入尼皮西斯河之前，在此扩展成湖。湖名与因努语中表示小水域或小河的词有关。因努家庭沿莫瓦西河流域往来海岸集会地点与内陆猎场，尼皮索湖也是这些旅程相关的水域之一。内陆过冬后，家庭在春天返回海岸。

sources.title: bilan ecologique et historique de la pointe de moisie.pdf

english: Nipissu is an Innu name for a lake south of the great river Mishta-shipu in the Labrador interior. Its outlet runs north to the river, through a country of forest, lakes and streams. Innu families travelled and hunted in the broad territory between Nipissu and the headwaters of the Eagle River, farther to the southeast. The lake was one of the places known to people whose seasonal journeys joined fishing waters with inland hunting grounds.
simp_chinese: 尼皮苏是拉布拉多内陆一座湖泊的因努语名，湖泊位于大河米什塔希普以南，出水向北穿过森林与溪湖汇入大河。因努家庭在尼皮苏与东南方伊格尔河源头之间的广阔地区行旅和狩猎。这座湖是他们熟知的地点之一，季节性旅程将此处渔场与内陆猎场连接起来。

english: Nir lies southwest of Ardabil on the uplands around Mount Sabalan. The great volcanic mountain dominates the surrounding plain, and springs rise in its foothills. Cold winters cover the higher ground with snow, while the valleys and grasslands provide pasture in the warmer months. Routes across this country connect the Ardabil basin with the towns and plateaus farther west.
simp_chinese: 尼尔位于阿尔达比勒西南方、萨巴兰山周围的高地上。这座巨大的火山俯瞰周围平原，山麓涌出泉水。寒冷冬季使高地覆雪，温暖季节则可利用山谷和草场放牧。穿越此地的道路连接阿尔达比勒盆地与更西方的城镇和高原。

english: Nirgua lies in the mountains of west-central Venezuela, in a country of valleys and gold-bearing streams. The Jirajara resisted Spanish incursions into the region for decades. In 1628 Governor Juan de Meneses y Padilla founded a Spanish settlement after a prolonged campaign against them. Colonial authorities distributed Indigenous labour through encomiendas and pursued gold extraction and farming in the surrounding country.
simp_chinese: 尼尔瓜位于委内瑞拉中西部山地，谷地与含金溪流交错。希拉哈拉人抵抗西班牙人侵入这一地区达数十年。1628年，总督胡安·德梅内塞斯-伊帕迪利亚在长期征战后建立西班牙聚落。殖民当局通过恩科米恩达分配原住民劳役，并在周围地区采金、发展农业。

english: Nirmal lies north of the Godavari in the wooded country of the northern Deccan. The town is known for its forts and for a tradition of painting and woodcraft practised by artisans called Naqash. Their painted work used local materials and often drew on stories from the epics, mythology and the natural world. Local rulers and later the Hyderabad court provided a setting in which these crafts could flourish alongside the fortified town.
simp_chinese: 尼尔马尔位于戈达瓦里河以北、德干北部的林地。城镇以堡垒和称为纳卡什的工匠所从事的绘画、木工传统闻名。他们利用当地材料绘制作品，题材常取自史诗、神话和自然世界。地方统治者及后来的海得拉巴宫廷为这些工艺提供环境，使它们在设防城镇中发展。

english: Nisa, or Nisa-Anasi, is a Papuan language of northern New Guinea in the country near Cenderawasih Bay. Its speakers inhabit a landscape of forest, rivers and coastal lowlands. The bay and its islands connect the shore to Biak and Yapen, while river routes lead inland towards the extensive wetlands of the Mamberamo region.
simp_chinese: 尼萨语又称尼萨－阿纳西语，是新几内亚北部极乐鸟湾附近的一种巴布亚语言。使用者居住在森林、河流和沿海低地构成的地区。海湾及其岛屿将海岸与比亚克、亚彭相连，河道则通往内陆曼贝拉莫地区的广阔湿地。

english: Nisab lies where Wadi Dura and Wadi Abadan meet to form Wadi Hammam in southern Yemen. The meeting of these valleys places it among the routes and irrigable lands of the dry interior. In the sixteenth century the town was ruled by the Umm Rusas family, against whom neighbouring Awlaki groups made an attack. Nisab later became associated with a branch of the Awlaki rulers, whose territories extended across the valleys between the highlands and the coast.
simp_chinese: 尼萨卜位于也门南部杜拉干河与阿巴丹干河交汇处，两河在此形成哈马姆干河。山谷交汇使它处在干旱内陆的道路与可灌溉土地之间。十六世纪，乌姆鲁萨斯家族统治城镇，邻近的奥拉基人曾向其发动攻击。尼萨卜后来与奥拉基统治者的一个支系相联系，其领地延伸于高地和海岸之间的诸山谷。

english: The Nisenan inhabited the watersheds of the Yuba and American Rivers, from California's Central Valley into the Sierra Nevada. Communities in the valley, foothills and mountains maintained their own local customs and leaders. The oak groves of the lower country supplied acorns, while rivers carried salmon from the valley towards the mountains. In 1833 a severe epidemic, believed to have been malaria, killed many Nisenan in the Central Valley; communities in the foothills were less affected.
simp_chinese: 尼塞南人居住在尤巴河和美洲河流域，土地从加利福尼亚中央谷地延伸至内华达山脉。谷地、山麓与山区的社群各有地方习俗和首领。低地橡树林提供橡实，河流中的鲑鱼则从谷地向山间洄游。1833年，一场据信为疟疾的严重流行病使中央谷地的许多尼塞南人丧生；山麓社群受到的影响较小。

english:
The Nisga’a homeland follows the Nass River through forested mountains towards the northern Pacific coast. Salmon and eulachon return to its waters, and river communities have long maintained ties with neighbours inland and on the coast. The Nisga’a call the river Lisims, and its places carry histories preserved by the houses and families of the valley.

Around the turn of the eighteenth century an eruption of the Tseax volcano transformed part of the valley. Lava flowed down the Tseax River and into the Nass, burying villages and changing the course of the water. Nisga’a oral histories remember the destruction and the many people who died; the dark lava beds remain a memorial to them. The precise date is uncertain, but the disaster left a deep mark on the history of the river and its people.
simp_chinese:
尼斯加人的故土沿纳斯河展开，河水穿过森林山地，流向北太平洋海岸。鲑鱼和油烛鱼在此回游，沿河社群长久以来与内陆及海岸邻人保持联系。尼斯加人称这条河为利西姆斯，河谷各处的故事由家屋和家庭世代保存。

十八世纪前后，策埃克斯火山喷发，改变了河谷的一部分。熔岩沿策埃克斯河流入纳斯河，掩埋村庄，改变了水流的路径。尼斯加口述历史记下了这场毁灭和众多死难者；黑色熔岩地至今是纪念他们的地方。这场灾难在河流及其居民的历史中留下了深刻印记。

english:
Nishapur, founded by the Sasanian king Shapur I, was one of the four great cities of Khorasan, on the Silk Road between the Iranian plateau and Central Asia, with turquoise mines nearby that supplied the world for two thousand years; Persians called it the turquoise city. The Mongols destroyed it in 1221, and quakes and later raids wrecked it again and again. The Ilkhans Ghazan and Abu Sa'id worked to revive it, and Hamdallah Mustawfi visited around 1339–1340. The inhabited city now lay northwest of the old one, around the mausoleum of the poet Attar and the congregational mosque, both built in this period. Ibn Battuta, who passed through about 1332, praised its gardens and madrasas.

Timur's empire took Nishapur in the 1380s. In 1404 Ruy González de Clavijo, envoy of Henry III of Castile, found it a rich farming centre with forty mills turning day and night on the Mir Ab. In 1581 the fort was besieged in the quarrel between Shah Muhammad Khodabanda and his son Abbas, and in 1592 Abbas took the city back from the Shaybanids; he built a caravanserai there and left two inscriptions on the congregational mosque in 1612. After Nader Shah's death in 1747 the Bayat chiefs ruled it as an independent khanate until Ahmad Shah Durrani seized it with heavy guns in 1754 and set up Shahrokh Shah as ruler of western Khorasan. The Qajars conquered Nishapur in 1800.
simp_chinese:
内沙布尔由萨珊国王沙普尔一世创建，是呼罗珊四大城市之一，位于连接伊朗高原与中亚的丝绸之路上，附近的绿松石矿两千年来供应着全世界；波斯人称它为绿松石之城。1221年蒙古人毁掉了它，地震和后来的劫掠一次又一次摧毁它。伊利汗合赞和不赛因设法让它复兴，哈姆杜拉·穆斯塔菲约于1339至1340年到访。有人居住的城区此时移到旧城西北，围绕着诗人阿塔尔的陵墓和聚礼清真寺，二者都建于这一时期。伊本·白图泰约1332年路过，称赞这里的园林和经学院。

1380年代，帖木儿帝国取得内沙布尔。1404年，卡斯蒂利亚国王亨利三世的使者鲁伊·冈萨雷斯·德·克拉维霍看到这里是富庶的农业中心，米尔河上有四十座磨坊昼夜转动。1581年，国王穆罕默德·霍达班达与儿子阿巴斯争位，内沙布尔的堡垒被围；1592年阿巴斯从昔班尼人手中夺回此城，在这里建了商队旅舍，1612年又在聚礼清真寺上留下两方铭文。1747年纳迪尔沙死后，巴亚特部首领以独立汗国的形式统治此地，1754年艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼用重炮攻占，扶植沙哈鲁沙为西呼罗珊统治者。1800年卡扎尔人征服内沙布尔。

english: Nishi lies along the western coast of southern Ezo, where mountains approach the Sea of Japan. At Kumaishi, Japanese settlers and Ainu lived in the same district, and a herring fishery grew along the shore. The Matsumae domain maintained a guard post on this frontier: travelers bound for Ainu country to trade or fish had to show permits obtained at Esashi. The post marked both a boundary of settlement and a place of exchange.
simp_chinese: 尔志位于虾夷地南部西岸，山地逼近日本海。在熊石，日本定居者与阿伊努人同居一地，沿海鲱鱼渔业逐渐发展。松前藩在这片边地设立番所：前往阿伊努地区贸易或捕鱼的人，必须出示在江差取得的通行凭证。番所既标示定居地的边界，也是双方往来的地点。

english: Western Kanbara is a low-lying plain of rivers, lagoons and rice fields in Echigo. Flooding and standing water made cultivation arduous: farmers worked in deep mud and raised their fields with soil carried by boat. Plans to drain the lagoons into the Sea of Japan met opposition from Niigata, which feared the loss of water needed by its port. Work finally began in 1818, and the Uchino Shinkawa channel was completed in 1820, passing beneath the Nishikawa by means of a buried conduit.
simp_chinese: 西蒲原是越后低平的平原，河川、潟湖与稻田交错。洪水和积水使耕作十分艰苦：农民在深泥中劳作，还用船运土垫高田地。将潟湖积水排入日本海的计划曾遭新潟町反对，因后者担心港口水量减少。工程终于在一八一八年动工，一八二〇年完成内野新川，并以埋设的伏管从西川下方穿过。

english: Western Kubiki lies where the Hime River descends from the mountains to the Sea of Japan at Itoigawa. Local tradition tells of Nunakawahime, a figure honored at shrines throughout the district, and of precious stones associated with her river. The Chikuni road followed the Hime valley inland toward Shinano, carrying salt from the coast. In 1717 a branch of the Matsudaira family became lords of Itoigawa, governing a small domain from the town.
simp_chinese: 西颈城位于姬川自群山流向日本海的地方，河口是糸鱼川。当地传说讲述奴奈川姬的故事，地区各处神社供奉这位神灵，她所居河流也与宝玉有关。千国街道沿姬川谷地通往内陆信浓，将海盐运入山中。一七一七年，松平氏一支入主糸鱼川，从城镇治理一座小藩。

english: Western Matsuura is a hilly district of Hizen famed for the porcelain kilns of Arita. Korean potters brought skills to the region after the invasions of Korea, and porcelain production took root in the early seventeenth century. From the 1650s, the Dutch East India Company exported Arita wares to Europe, where they were sought by princes and collectors. Disruption to Chinese porcelain exports helped open this distant market to the kilns of Hizen.
simp_chinese: 西松浦是肥前的丘陵地区，以有田瓷窑闻名。侵朝战争后，朝鲜陶工将技艺带到此地，十七世纪初瓷器生产开始扎根。自十七世纪五十年代起，荷兰东印度公司将有田瓷器运往欧洲，受到王公和收藏者追捧。中国瓷器出口受战乱影响，也为肥前窑场打开了远方市场。

english: Western Morokata lies in the upland basins of Hyūga near the borders of Satsuma and Higo. In 1572 an Itō army advanced from Kobayashi against Shimazu positions at Iino. The armies fought at Kizakibaru, where the Itō suffered a severe defeat. The battle weakened their hold on Hyūga and strengthened the Shimazu position in the mountain country between their Satsuma base and the eastern plains.
simp_chinese: 西诸县位于日向高地盆地，靠近萨摩和肥后边界。1572年，伊东军从小林出发，进攻饭野的岛津据点。两军在木崎原交战，伊东氏遭受惨败。这场战斗削弱了伊东氏对日向的控制，也加强了岛津氏在萨摩本据与东部平原之间山地的地位。

english: Western Muro lies on Kii's coast, where the old pilgrimage roads to Kumano leave Tanabe and enter the peninsula. At Misuguchi the route divides: the Nakahechi turns inland through the mountains, while the Ōhechi follows the coast. Travellers bound for the sacred places of Kumano passed through the town before choosing their road. A wayside marker preserved the direction to the inland path, a reminder of the long procession of pilgrims.
simp_chinese: 西牟娄位于纪伊海岸，前往熊野的古老巡礼道从田边进入半岛。在三栖口，道路分为两支：中边路转向内陆穿越山地，大边路则沿海岸前行。前往熊野圣地的旅人经过城镇后，在此选择路线。路旁石标指向内陆的熊野道，见证了络绎不绝的朝圣者。

english: Western Okitama includes the Nagai basin on the upper reaches of the Mogami River. In the Edo period, river transport gave this mountain-bound part of the Yonezawa domain a route to distant markets. Landings at Miya and Koide became collecting points for goods, and the settlements developed as merchants' towns. Rice and other products passed through their warehouses on the way downriver, while supplies travelled back into the basin.
simp_chinese: 西置赐包括最上川上游的长井盆地。江户时代，水运为群山环抱的米泽藩领地开辟了通往远方市场的道路。宫、小出的船场成为货物集散地，两处聚落也发展为商人町。稻米及其他物产经仓库沿河运出，所需物资则循水路进入盆地。

english: Western Sonogi faces the sea along the indented coast of Hizen. Nagasaki developed as a port of overseas trade and, after the shogunate restricted foreign contacts, remained a closely controlled gateway to China and the Netherlands. In 1641 the Dutch trading post moved from Hirado to the small artificial island of Dejima. Chinese merchants continued to visit the port, later residing in a designated compound. Goods, books and knowledge passed through Nagasaki despite the restrictions on travel.
simp_chinese: 西彼杵位于肥前曲折的海岸，面向外海。长崎发展为海外贸易港；幕府限制对外往来后，它仍是受到严格管制的中荷贸易门户。1641年，荷兰商馆从平户迁至人工岛出岛。中国商人继续来港，后来居住在指定的唐人屋敷。即使旅行受到限制，货物、书籍和知识仍经长崎流通。

english: Western Usuki lies among the steep mountains of northern Hyūga, around Takachiho. Here communities preserve a form of kagura performed through the night, with dances welcoming the gods and retelling sacred stories. In the Edo period the rituals were transmitted around the priests of Takachiho Shrine; by the later years of that era, village houses also served as places for the performances. Masks, music and dance brought the world of the gods into mountain settlements.
simp_chinese: 西臼杵位于日向北部的陡峭山地，环绕高千穗。当地社群传承通宵演出的夜神乐，以舞蹈迎接神灵并讲述神话。江户时代，这些仪式围绕高千穗神社的神职传承；到了后期，村民住宅也成为演出场所。面具、音乐与舞蹈把神灵世界带入山中聚落。

english: The Nishnabotna River drains the rolling country of southwestern Iowa and flows toward the Missouri. Its eastern and western branches meet near the southern edge of Iowa, and the joined river continues into Missouri before reaching the larger river. The name has traditionally been interpreted as an Otoe word for a river where canoes were made. Its winding course and tributaries connect a broad area of prairie and river valleys with the Missouri basin.
simp_chinese: 尼什纳博特纳河为艾奥瓦西南部起伏的土地排水，向密苏里河流去。东、西两支在艾奥瓦南缘附近汇合，合流后进入密苏里，最终注入大河。河名传统上被解释为奥托语中制造独木舟的河流。蜿蜒河道和支流将广阔的草原、河谷与密苏里河流域连接起来。

english: Nisiamk is a Mi'kmaw name for the Sable River on the south coast of Nova Scotia. Its meaning has been associated with water flowing over sand, a description of the river's course toward the Atlantic. Nearby inlets such as Port Joli and Port L'Hebert offered sheltered water along a coast of islands and bays. The Mi'kmaq traveled and gathered food along these shores long before European settlements spread across the peninsula.
simp_chinese: 尼西亚姆克是新斯科舍南岸塞布尔河的米克马克语名称，与河水流过沙地的景象有关。河流流向大西洋，附近的若利港和埃贝尔港等海湾在岛屿与海岸之间提供避风水域。早在欧洲聚落遍布半岛之前，米克马克人便沿这片海岸往来并采集食物。

sources.title: A list of Micmac names of places, rivers, etc., in Nova Scotia

english: The Niskibi River flows through the lowlands west of Hudson Bay, a northern country of wetlands and waterways. Its name comes from Swampy Cree, the language of people whose homeland extends across the bay lowlands. In this region the Severn River provides a route from the inland lakes to the coast, crossing a landscape shaped by long winters and extensive muskeg.
simp_chinese: 尼斯基比河流经哈得孙湾以西的低地，这片北方土地遍布湿地与水道。河名来自沼泽克里语，使用这一语言的人们以海湾低地为家园。在这一地区，塞文河从内陆湖区通向海岸，沿途经过冬季漫长、泥沼广布的土地。

english: Nisohone was a name recorded for the Nasoni, a Caddo people of northeastern Texas. Their communities included an upper group near the Red River and a lower group among the Hasinai farther south. The latter lived near other Caddo settlements in the wooded country of the Angelina and Sabine rivers. In 1716 Spanish missionaries founded San José de los Nazones among the lower Nasoni. Disease and warfare later reduced the numbers of both groups.
simp_chinese: 尼索霍内是纳索尼人的一个记载名称。这支得克萨斯东北部的卡多民族分为红河附近的上游群体和更南方哈西奈地区的下游群体。下游纳索尼人与其他卡多社群相邻，生活在安赫利纳河与萨宾河之间的林地。1716年，西班牙传教士在下游纳索尼人中建立圣何塞德洛斯纳索内斯传教站。此后疾病与战争使两支群体的人数减少。

english: The Nisqually people lived along the river that flows from the Cascade Mountains into southern Puget Sound. Salmon formed a foundation of their diet and culture, joining the river's mountain reaches with its estuary. In 1833 the Hudson's Bay Company established Fort Nisqually as a fur-trading post near the river's mouth, bringing a new commercial presence into the homeland of the Nisqually and their neighbors.
simp_chinese: 尼斯阔利人生活在尼斯阔利河沿岸，这条河从喀斯喀特山脉流入普吉特湾南部。鲑鱼是他们饮食与文化的基础，将山间河段和河口联系在一起。1833年，哈德逊湾公司在河口附近建立尼斯阔利堡，作为毛皮贸易据点，为尼斯阔利人及其邻族的家园带来了新的商业力量。

english: Nissouri is a country of streams and wooded land inland from the Great Lakes. Its name has been associated with an Indigenous expression for running water, a fitting description of the many watercourses crossing the area. The township was surveyed around 1820, and its early settlers held a town meeting by 1822. Roads and mills followed as more families arrived during the 1820s, including immigrants from Britain and families who had come from Pennsylvania after the American Revolution.
simp_chinese: 尼苏里位于五大湖内陆，是一片溪流与森林交错的土地。地名被认为与一个意为“流动的水”的原住民词汇有关，与穿过这里的众多水道相称。乡区约于1820年完成测量，早期移民到1822年已召开乡镇会议。更多家庭在1820年代迁入，道路和磨坊随之出现；新居民包括英国移民，也有美国革命后从宾夕法尼亚迁来的家庭。

english: Nistam, meaning “the first lake” in Cree, lies in the forested country east of James Bay. The nearby Rupert River winds through lakes and rapids on its way west to the bay, where it reaches Waskaganish. In the seventeenth century a trading post was established at the river mouth, drawing Cree hunters and traders into new exchanges while the waterways continued to connect the coast with the interior.
simp_chinese: 尼斯塔姆在克里语中意为“第一座湖”，位于詹姆斯湾以东的森林地带。附近的鲁珀特河穿过湖泊和急流，向西流往瓦斯卡加尼什，注入海湾。十七世纪，河口建立了贸易站，克里猎人和商人与外来者展开新的交换；水道则继续将海岸与广阔的内陆相连接。

english: Nita lies among the wooded mountains of inland Izumo, a district long associated with tatara ironmaking. Its furnaces used iron sand and charcoal to produce iron and steel, drawing on materials found in the surrounding country. By 1726, records describe a tatara operation at Nita; the craft and its demand for fuel tied the work of the furnace to the forests and streams of the mountain villages.
simp_chinese: 仁多位于出云内陆的林木山地，长期以踏鞴炼铁闻名。炉匠利用当地的砂铁和木炭炼制铁与钢，山林中的资源因此被送入炉中。到1726年，文献已记载仁多的踏鞴作业；炼炉的技艺和燃料需求，将工场与山村周围的森林、溪流联系在一起。

english: Nita' is an old watering place and village in Wadi al-Miyah, the long depression east of the al-Suman plateau. Its well was known for abundant fresh water, and the place appears in early Arabic geographical writing and poetry. Palm cultivation grew around the water, while the neighbouring lowlands included the salt flat of Nita'. In this dry part of eastern Arabia, the well served both people and their animals.
simp_chinese: 尼塔是苏曼高原以东米亚谷中的古老水源地和村落。这里的井以淡水充沛著称，早期阿拉伯地理著作和诗歌中便提到此地。水源周围种植棕榈，邻近低地还有尼塔盐沼。在阿拉伯东部这片干旱地区，水井为人和牲畜提供饮水。

english: Nit’ahéndé is a name associated with a Mescalero Apache group of the mountains of southern New Mexico. The group ranged along the Rio Bonito and Rio Hondo and through the Capitan and Sacramento mountains. These ranges and their valleys formed part of a wider Apache homeland between the Rio Grande and the Pecos, where families moved to hunt and gather the foods of different elevations.
simp_chinese: 尼塔亨德是与新墨西哥南部山区一支梅斯卡莱罗阿帕奇群体相关的名称。该群体活动于博尼托河、翁多河沿岸以及卡皮坦山和萨克拉门托山一带。这些山脉与山谷属于格兰德河和佩科斯河之间更广阔的阿帕奇故土，家庭随不同海拔的食物资源移动，狩猎并采集。

english: Nitamibontegw is an Abenaki name for the first falls on Otter Creek, upstream from its mouth on Lake Champlain. The river was a route through the valley for Indigenous communities, linking the lake with the interior. A sawmill was built at the falls in 1764, and the settlement that grew there became Vergennes. During the War of 1812, American forces assembled a fleet at the falls for the battle fought on Lake Champlain in 1814.
simp_chinese: 尼塔米邦特格是阿贝纳基人对水獭溪第一处瀑布的称呼，瀑布位于河流注入尚普兰湖的河口上游。原住民社群利用这条河穿行于河谷，连接湖区与内陆。1764年，瀑布旁建起一座锯木厂，后来发展的聚落成为韦尔热讷。1812年战争期间，美军在瀑布附近集结舰队，参加了1814年的尚普兰湖战斗。

english: Nito was a Maya trading settlement near the mouth of the Río Dulce, where the waters of Lake Izabal reach the Caribbean. Merchants from several regions gathered there, bringing goods along the coastal and inland waterways. A Spanish raid around 1524 seized the town and its merchandise, causing the traders to flee. Hernán Cortés reached the area in 1525 during his difficult journey to Honduras and found the once-busy port disrupted by the intrusion.
simp_chinese: 尼托是杜尔塞河口附近的一处玛雅贸易聚落，伊萨瓦尔湖的水由此流向加勒比海。来自多个地区的商人在此聚集，沿海岸和内陆水道运送货物。约1524年，西班牙人袭击城镇，夺取商品，迫使商人逃离。1525年，埃尔南·科尔特斯艰难跋涉前往洪都拉斯时抵达此地，发现这座曾经繁忙的港口已被入侵打乱。

english:
Nitra rises above the river of the same name, its castle hill holding the cathedral and residence of the bishop. A centre of early Slavic power and later an episcopal seat in the Kingdom of Hungary, it grew into a town beneath the fortified height. King Béla IV granted its inhabitants privileges in 1248 after the castle had resisted the Mongol invasion.

The town and castle suffered during the struggles of the late Middle Ages, including a Hussite siege in 1432. Ottoman raids began in the sixteenth century, prompting further strengthening of the defences. In 1663 the Ottomans captured both town and castle and damaged the cathedral, but imperial forces recovered the stronghold the following year. Bishop Tomáš Pálffy then had its defences rebuilt. The castle was fought over again during the uprising of Francis II Rákóczi; after the war, Bishop Ladislav Adam Erdődy reconstructed the church and built a new episcopal palace.
simp_chinese:
尼特拉坐落在同名河流之畔，城堡山上有主教座堂和主教居所。这里曾是早期斯拉夫势力的中心，后来成为匈牙利王国的主教驻地，城镇在设防的高地下方发展起来。1248年，贝拉四世国王在城堡抵御蒙古入侵后，向居民授予特权。

中世纪晚期的战乱使城镇和城堡受损，1432年的胡斯派围攻便是其中之一。十六世纪，奥斯曼军队开始袭扰此地，促使守方继续加固城防。1663年，奥斯曼军队占领城镇与城堡，主教座堂遭到破坏；次年帝国军收复要塞。主教托马什·帕尔菲随后重建防御工事。弗朗茨二世·拉科齐起义期间，城堡再次成为争夺目标；战后，主教拉迪斯拉夫·亚当·厄尔德迪重建教堂，兴建新的主教宫。

english: The Nitrian Desert stretches west of Egypt's Nile Delta, a land of sand, stone and salt-bearing depressions. In late antiquity its solitude drew Christian hermits seeking lives of prayer. Monastic communities grew at Nitria, Kellia and Scetis, the last in Wadi El Natrun. Although Nitria and Kellia were eventually abandoned, Scetis remained inhabited through the Middle Ages, preserving a tradition that began with the desert fathers of the fourth century.
simp_chinese: 尼特里亚沙漠延伸在埃及尼罗河三角洲以西，遍布沙石和含盐洼地。古代晚期，这片幽寂之地吸引了寻求祈祷生活的基督教隐修者。尼特里亚、凯利亚和斯凯提斯相继形成修道群体，其中斯凯提斯位于奈特伦谷。尽管尼特里亚和凯利亚最终被废弃，斯凯提斯在中世纪仍有人居住，延续了四世纪沙漠教父开创的传统。

english: Nitta lies in the eastern plain of Kōzuke, where the Nitta family developed a large estate in the twelfth century. Its descendants became prominent warriors of the eastern provinces. In 1333 Nitta Yoshisada raised his banner at Ikushina Shrine and marched against the Kamakura shogunate. His campaign ended with the fall of Kamakura and the Hōjō regency, carrying the name of this provincial estate into the politics of the whole country.
simp_chinese: 新田位于上野东部平原。十二世纪，新田氏在此开发广阔庄园，其后裔成为东国重要武家。1333年，新田义贞在生品神社举兵，进攻镰仓幕府。镰仓和北条执权政权随之覆灭，使这处地方庄园的名字与全国政局联系在一起。

english: South of Tonga’s northern Niuas, the Pacific connects Niuatoputapu and Niuafoʻou with the islands farther south. Dutch navigators Willem Schouten and Jacob Le Maire reached the northern islands in 1616, encountering communities that already maintained relationships across the Tongan archipelago.
simp_chinese: 汤加北部纽阿群岛以南，太平洋连接纽阿托普塔普、纽阿福欧和更南方的岛屿。1616年，荷兰航海家威廉·斯豪滕和雅各布·勒梅尔抵达北部岛屿，遇见早已在汤加群岛间维持联系的社群。

english: Southeast of Niuatoputapu, the open Pacific Ocean separates the northern Tongan islands from Niue. Dutch navigators Willem Schouten and Jacob Le Maire encountered Niuatoputapu in 1616, while its Polynesian inhabitants already belonged to a wider world of island voyaging and chiefly relationships.
simp_chinese: 纽阿托普塔普东南方的开阔大洋将汤加北部岛屿与纽埃隔开。1616年，荷兰航海家威廉·斯豪滕和雅各布·勒梅尔来到纽阿托普塔普，当地波利尼西亚居民早已参与更广阔的岛际航行与酋长关系网络。

english: North of Niuafoʻou, the Pacific lies between Tonga’s northern islands and Samoa. Polynesian communities inhabited these islands long before European arrival. In 1616 Willem Schouten and Jacob Le Maire sailed through the Niuas, encountering Niuafoʻou and Niuatoputapu on their westward voyage.
simp_chinese: 纽阿福欧以北的太平洋位于汤加北部岛屿与萨摩亚之间。早在欧洲人到来之前，波利尼西亚社群已在这些岛屿生活。1616年，威廉·斯豪滕和雅各布·勒梅尔向西航行经过纽阿群岛，遇见了纽阿福欧和纽阿托普塔普。

english: East of Niuatoputapu, open waters extend between Tonga and Samoa. In 1616 the Dutch expedition of Willem Schouten and Jacob Le Maire encountered the northern Tongan islands. The voyagers met islanders whose communities were linked by canoe travel across this part of the Pacific.
simp_chinese: 纽阿托普塔普以东的开阔水域延伸在汤加与萨摩亚之间。1616年，威廉·斯豪滕和雅各布·勒梅尔的荷兰船队遇见汤加北部岛屿。航海者见到了岛民，他们的社群通过独木舟航行联系在一起。

english: Niuafoʻou is a volcanic island in northern Tonga, its high rim surrounding a crater lake. Steep shores and reefs make landing difficult. In 1616 the Dutch voyagers Willem Schouten and Jacob Le Maire passed the northern Tongan islands, meeting people whose canoes carried them across the sea between island communities.
simp_chinese: 纽阿福欧是汤加北部的火山岛，高耸的火山口边缘围绕着湖泊。陡岸与礁盘使登岸并不容易。1616年，荷兰航行者威廉·斯豪滕和雅各布·勒梅尔经过汤加北部岛屿，遇到乘独木舟在岛屿社群之间航行的人们。

english: Niuafoʻou is a volcanic island in northern Tonga, its steep coast rising above the Pacific. Polynesian communities lived here long before the arrival of Dutch navigators Willem Schouten and Jacob Le Maire in 1616. Their expedition named the island Good Hope during a westward voyage across the ocean.
simp_chinese: 纽阿福欧是汤加北部的一座火山岛，陡峭海岸从太平洋上升起。早在荷兰航海家威廉·斯豪滕和雅各布·勒梅尔于1616年抵达之前，波利尼西亚社群已在岛上生活。他们横渡大洋向西航行时，将该岛命名为好望岛。

english: Niuatoputapu is a volcanic island in northern Tonga, close to the steep island of Tafahi. In 1616 Willem Schouten and Jacob Le Maire encountered its people during a Dutch voyage across the Pacific. Trading gave way to conflict as armed islanders approached in canoes and the visitors fired their weapons before sailing westward.
simp_chinese: 纽阿托普塔普是汤加北部的一座火山岛，邻近陡峭的塔法希岛。1616年，威廉·斯豪滕和雅各布·勒梅尔在荷兰横渡太平洋的航行中遇到岛民。双方先有交易，随后发生冲突：武装岛民乘独木舟靠近，访客开火后向西驶离。

english: Niuatoputapu lies in northern Tonga, near the steep volcanic island of Tafahi in the Pacific. In 1616 the Dutch expedition of Willem Schouten and Jacob Le Maire encountered its inhabitants. Violence broke out during the meeting, and the Dutch named Niuatoputapu Traitors’ Island.
simp_chinese: 纽阿托普塔普位于汤加北部，靠近陡峭的塔法希火山岛。1616年，威廉·斯豪滕和雅各布·勒梅尔的荷兰船队遇见当地居民。双方相遇期间发生暴力冲突，荷兰人将纽阿托普塔普命名为“叛徒岛”。

english:
Niue is a raised coral island in the South Pacific, with steep coastal cliffs and a broad limestone plateau rising above the surrounding coral reef. Its Polynesian people preserve traditions of voyaging and links with Samoa and Tonga. Their language reflects these connections across the ocean; unlike an atoll, the island has no sheltered central lagoon.

In 1774 James Cook approached Niue on his second voyage across the Pacific Ocean. His attempts to land met determined resistance from islanders, and he sailed away after he named it Savage Island. In 1830 the missionary John Williams also visited, but a lasting mission was not established during his visit. The islanders’ reception of outsiders reflected the importance of defending their shores and their autonomy.
simp_chinese:
纽埃是南太平洋一座隆起的珊瑚岛，陡峭海崖与宽阔石灰岩高原耸立于周围珊瑚礁之上。当地波利尼西亚人保存着航行传统和与萨摩亚、汤加的联系，其语言反映了这些跨海联系；它不像环礁那样有受庇护的中央潟湖。

1774年，詹姆斯·库克在第二次横越太平洋的航行中驶近纽埃。他试图登岸时遇到岛民坚决抵抗，于是将其称为野蛮岛后驶离。1830年，传教士约翰·威廉斯也曾到访，但未在此建立持久的传教站。岛民对外来者的回应反映出守护海岸与自主地位的重要性。

english: Niue rises from the Pacific as a high coral island, its coast edged by cliffs and reef. Polynesian communities inhabited it before James Cook arrived in 1774. His attempts to approach the shore met resistance from islanders, and he gave Niue the name Savage Island.
simp_chinese: 纽埃是一座从太平洋中升起的高珊瑚岛，海岸边缘有崖壁和珊瑚礁。詹姆斯·库克于1774年到来之前，波利尼西亚社群已在岛上生活。他试图靠近海岸时遭到岛民抵抗，便将纽埃命名为“野人岛”。

english: North of Niue, open ocean lies between the raised coral island and the Samoan archipelago. Niue was inhabited by Polynesian communities before James Cook visited in 1774. His attempts to come ashore met resistance, leading him to give the island the name Savage Island.
simp_chinese: 纽埃以北的开阔大洋位于这座隆起的珊瑚岛与萨摩亚群岛之间。詹姆斯·库克于1774年到访之前，波利尼西亚社群已在纽埃生活。他试图上岸时遭到抵抗，因此将岛屿命名为“野人岛”。

english: Northeast of Niue, the open Pacific extends away from the island’s steep coral coast. The island was already inhabited when James Cook arrived in 1774. His landing attempts encountered resistance from Niueans, and he left with a name for the island that reflected this brief encounter.
simp_chinese: 纽埃东北方的开阔太平洋从岛屿陡峭的珊瑚海岸向外延伸。詹姆斯·库克于1774年到来时岛上已有居民。他的登陆尝试遭到纽埃人抵抗，离开时给岛屿起了一个反映这次短暂接触的名字。

english: East of Niue, open water stretches beyond this isolated coral island in the South Pacific. Polynesian settlers had established communities there long before European contact. James Cook reached Niue in 1774; resistance to his attempts to approach its shore led him to name it Savage Island.
simp_chinese: 纽埃以东的开阔水域延伸至这座孤立的南太平洋珊瑚岛之外。与欧洲人接触以前，波利尼西亚移民早已在岛上建立社群。詹姆斯·库克于1774年抵达纽埃；他靠岸时遭到抵抗，于是将其命名为“野人岛”。

english: South of Niue, the Pacific separates the raised coral island from other Polynesian landfalls. In 1774 James Cook visited Niue during his second Pacific voyage. The islanders resisted his attempts to approach the shore, and the name he gave the island recorded the strained encounter.
simp_chinese: 纽埃以南，太平洋将这座隆起的珊瑚岛与波利尼西亚其他陆地隔开。1774年，詹姆斯·库克在第二次太平洋航行期间到访纽埃。岛民抵抗他靠岸的尝试，他给岛屿起的名字记录了这次紧张的接触。

english: Niugtaq lies on the Ninglick River north of Nelson Island, amid the lakes and channels of the Yukon-Kuskokwim Delta. Its Yup’ik name means the rustling of grass. The people of this coast and Nelson Island are known as Qaluyaarmiut, or “dip-net people,” whose ancestors have lived in the region for thousands of years. Their seasonal movements joined winter settlements on the mainland with summer fishing camps on the island. Fish and marine animals were central to life in this treeless coastal country.
simp_chinese: 纽格塔克位于宁利克河畔、纳尔逊岛以北，周围是育空—库斯科奎姆三角洲的湖泊与河道。它的尤皮克语名称意为草丛沙沙作响。这片海岸及纳尔逊岛的人们称为卡卢亚尔缪特，即“抄网的人们”，其祖先在这一地区生活已有数千年。季节性的迁移将大陆上的冬季聚落与岛上的夏季渔营相连，鱼类和海兽是这片无树海岸地区生活的重要基础。

english: Niuoku is an islet on Nukulaelae Atoll in southern Tuvalu, where low coral land borders a lagoon and the open Pacific. Polynesian communities lived on the atoll long before outside ships arrived. In 1821 the whaler Independence II sighted Nukulaelae during the expansion of whaling into the central Pacific.
simp_chinese: 纽奥库是图瓦卢南部努库莱莱环礁上的小岛，低矮珊瑚岛陆濒临潟湖与开阔的太平洋。外来船只到来之前，波利尼西亚社群早已在环礁上生活。1821年，捕鲸船独立二号望见努库莱莱；当时捕鲸活动正向中太平洋扩展。

english: Across the Tuvalu sea, coral islands rise only a little above the Pacific. The island communities preserved ties to Samoa and Tonga through traditions of settlement and contact. In 1568 Álvaro de Mendaña sailed past Nui and called it Isla de Jesús; the inhabited atoll entered the records of Spanish navigation.
simp_chinese: 图瓦卢海中，珊瑚岛仅略微高出太平洋水面。岛民的定居与交往传统保存着同萨摩亚和汤加的联系。1568年，阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚驶过努伊，将其称为耶稣岛；这座已有居民的环礁由此进入西班牙航海记录。

english: The low islands and reefs of Tuvalu are separated by long stretches of ocean. Nui, in the northern part of the chain, was settled by people from the Gilbert Islands and retains a Gilbertese language. In 1825 Dutch vessels called at Nui, sending a boat ashore and encountering the islanders.
simp_chinese: 图瓦卢的低岛和礁盘之间隔着漫长海面。岛链北部的努伊由吉尔伯特群岛移民定居，保留着吉尔伯特语。1825年，荷兰船只抵达努伊，派小艇登岸，与当地岛民相遇。

sources.title: K Chambers Heirs of Tefolaha with bookmarks - 4 Oct 08.pdf

english: Niuquanzi lies in the bleak country of the Mazong Mountains, north of the Hexi Corridor. Low hills flank a broad basin of gravel and sand, with dry gullies crossing the desert floor. The surrounding ranges stretch toward the Mongolian frontier and the eastern edge of the Lop Nur depression. Vegetation is sparse and distances are great, although scattered springs and patches of grass break the long stretches of exposed ground in the wider mountain region.
simp_chinese: 牛圈子位于河西走廊以北荒凉的马鬃山地区。低丘夹着宽阔的沙砾盆地，干涸沟谷横穿戈壁。周围山岭向蒙古边境及罗布泊洼地东缘延伸，植被稀疏，道路漫长；群山广大地域内零散的泉水与草地，点缀着大片裸露地面。

english: Nyurba lies beside the Vilyuy in western Yakutia, where forest, lakes and meadows line the river valley. The Vilyuy flows east to the Lena and forms a long waterway through the northern interior. Local tradition remembers Nyurbakan as an ancestral figure associated with the lake from which the place takes its name. In the early 1820s inhabitants dug a channel to drain Lake Nyurba into the Vilyuy. The work, completed in 1824, opened land at the former lake site and became a notable episode in the history of the settlement. The river continued to connect the district with other communities along the Vilyuy, while the newly drained ground gave people room to make use of the valley.
simp_chinese: 纽尔巴位于雅库特西部维柳伊河畔，森林、湖泊和草地分布在河谷中。维柳伊河向东流入勒拿河，是贯通北方内陆的漫长水道。地方传说将纽尔巴坎视为与同名湖泊有关的祖先人物。十九世纪二十年代初，当地居民开挖渠道，将纽尔巴湖排入维柳伊河。工程于1824年完成，原湖床露出土地，成为聚落历史上的一件大事。河流继续连接维柳伊河沿岸的其他社区，新排干的地面则为人们利用河谷提供了空间。

sources.title: IV нпк География и краеведение. Озера Хол.регионов 2016.pdf

english: Niushan lies in the mountain country north of the Great Wall. In 1077 the Song envoy Su Song travelled through this region on a mission to the Liao court and wrote a poem about the road through Niushan. His account described cultivated ground and cattle and sheep filling the valleys, a glimpse of farming and pastoral life in the lands governed by the Khitan dynasty.
simp_chinese: 牛山位于长城以北的山地。1077年，宋朝使臣苏颂出使辽国，途经此地并写下《牛山道中》。诗中所见耕地广阔、牛羊遍谷，为契丹王朝统治下的农牧生活留下了一幅生动的画面。

english: Niutao is a low coral island in northern Tuvalu, with inland lakes and a reef along its shore. Its oral history remembers encounters with voyagers and raiders from other islands, including a battle on the reef in which Tongan warriors were defeated. Such traditions recall Niutao’s place within the voyaging world of the central Pacific.
simp_chinese: 纽陶是图瓦卢北部的一座低矮珊瑚岛，岛内有湖泊，岸边环绕礁石。当地口传历史记述与其他岛屿航海者和袭击者的遭遇，包括一场在礁上击败汤加武士的战斗。这些传说记载了纽陶在太平洋中部航海世界中的地位。

english:
Niuwu belongs to the southern Yunnan country associated with Simao, where cultivated valleys and forested hills connect the southwest with mainland Southeast Asia. Communities used different elevations for crops, livestock and gathered resources. Roads followed valleys and crossed passes, with travel shaped by terrain and seasonal rain.

Across southern Yunnan, imperial officials and hereditary local rulers maintained varied relationships during the Yuan, Ming and Qing periods. The wider region also formed part of Tai and other Southeast Asian cultural networks. Tea and forest products connected some districts with distant markets, while farming remained central to many households.
simp_chinese:
钮兀属于云南南部的思茅地区，耕作河谷和森林丘陵将西南地区同东南亚大陆联系起来。社群在不同海拔耕种、畜牧和采集。道路沿河谷跨越山口，旅程受到地形和季节降雨的影响。

元明清时期，云南南部各地的朝廷官员和世袭地方统治者之间存在不同的治理关系。更广阔地区也是傣族及其他东南亚文化网络的一部分。茶叶和林产将部分地区同远方市场联系起来，耕作则仍是许多家庭的生计基础。

english: Nivelles grew around the abbey founded by Itta in the seventh century, whose first abbess was her daughter Gertrude. Pilgrimage to the saint helped the settlement develop, and the great Romanesque church was dedicated in 1046. The town became part of the Duchy of Brabant in the thirteenth century. Its artisans and guilds contested the authority of the abbesses and dukes, winning rights from Duchess Joanna in the fourteenth century. In 1647 unrest among thread manufacturers was followed by the departure of many entrepreneurs for France. Sieges and occupations during the wars between France and the Spanish Netherlands added to the town's difficulties. In the eighteenth century Austrian and French administrations introduced religious and administrative reforms, while the church of St Gertrude remained the centre of local devotion.
simp_chinese: 尼韦勒围绕伊塔于七世纪建立的修道院发展，她的女儿格特鲁德是首任女院长。前来朝拜圣徒的信众推动聚落成长，宏大的罗曼式教堂于1046年举行奉献仪式。十三世纪，城镇成为布拉班特公国的一部分。工匠和行会与女院长及公爵争取权利，十四世纪终于从布拉班特女公爵约翰娜处获得特权。1647年，线业制造者发生动乱，其后许多企业经营者迁往法国。法国与西属尼德兰之间的战争又使城镇遭遇围攻和军事占领。十八世纪奥地利和法国政权带来宗教与行政改革，圣格特鲁德教堂仍是地方信仰的中心。

english: Niwa lies in northern Owari along the Kiso River, where Inuyama Castle stands above the water. Tradition dates the castle to 1537, when Oda Nobuyasu moved his residence to the hill beside the river. During the fighting of 1584, forces supporting Toyotomi Hideyoshi crossed the Kiso and seized Inuyama as a base. In 1617 Naruse Masanari, a senior retainer of the Owari Tokugawa, received the castle and established a long family tenure.
simp_chinese: 丹羽位于尾张北部木曾川沿岸，犬山城高踞河畔。相传织田信康于1537年将居所迁至此处山丘，修筑城堡。1584年战事中，丰臣秀吉一方越过木曾川夺取犬山，以之为据点。1617年，尾张德川家的重臣成濑正成获赐此城，家族此后长期居守。

english: Ñíxgu is an Ioway and Otoe name for the Cimarron River, a watercourse of the southern Plains. Rising in the dry country to the west, the river winds eastward across the plains to join the Arkansas. Its name is associated with the salty water carried from its upper basin. Broad sandy stretches and variable flows mark a river that connects the high plains with the greener country farther east.
simp_chinese: 尼克斯古是艾奥瓦语和奥托语中西马龙河的名称。这条南部平原河流发源于西部干旱地区，蜿蜒向东流入阿肯色河；其名称与上游流域带来的咸水有关。宽阔的沙地和变化不定的水流是这条河的特征，它将高平原与更东方青翠的地区联系起来。

sources.title: シマロン川 (アーカンソー川の支流)

english: Nixi lies among the mountains northwest of Zhongdian, on a route toward Tibet. In Tangdui village, Tibetan potters use local red and white clays to make dark earthenware vessels by hand. Pots, tea jars and braziers serve the needs of households in the highlands. Pottery found in ancient stone tombs in the district includes forms resembling the village's black ware, linking this craft to a much older history of working local clay.
simp_chinese: 尼西位于中甸西北的群山之间，处在通往藏地的道路上。汤堆村的藏族陶工用当地红土与白土手工制作黑陶，陶锅、茶罐和火盆供高原人家日常使用。当地古代石棺墓中出土的陶器有些形制与黑陶相似，显示利用本地泥土制器的历史十分悠久。

english: Niya is an oasis on the southern edge of the Taklamakan, watered by a river descending from the Kunlun Mountains. Farther north in the desert lie the remains of an ancient settlement associated with Jingjue, a small kingdom mentioned in Han records. Wooden houses, fields and objects preserved in the dry sand recall a time when water reached farther into the basin. Documents written in Kharosthi on wooden tablets record official orders and everyday affairs in the third and fourth centuries.
simp_chinese: 尼雅是塔克拉玛干南缘的绿洲，来自昆仑山的河水滋养着这里。更北面的沙漠中散布着古代聚落遗迹，与汉代文献记载的小国精绝有关。干燥沙土中保存的木屋、田地与器物，让人想起河水曾流得更深入盆地的时代。以佉卢文写在木简上的文书，记录了三至四世纪的政令和日常事务。

english: Niyaj is a Wichí community name in the wooded country of the Argentine Chaco, near the Bermejo River. The Wichí speak languages of the Mataguayan family and traditionally hunted, fished and gathered across extensive territories. Their forest knowledge includes plants used for food and fibre, while rivers supplied fish and routes through the lowlands. Rainfall and flooding vary greatly between the wet and dry seasons.
simp_chinese: 尼亚赫是阿根廷查科林地中、贝尔梅霍河附近一个韦奇社群的名称。韦奇人使用马塔瓜约语族语言，传统上在广阔领地内狩猎、捕鱼与采集。他们熟悉森林中可食用和可取纤维的植物，河流则提供鱼产及穿过低地的通道。湿季和旱季的降雨及洪水情况差异显著。

english:
Niyazabad was a port of Shirvan on the western Caspian, between Baku and Derbent. Ships and caravans connected it with the inland markets of Shamakhi and with ports across the sea. It figured in the accounts of European travelers and diplomats who followed the Volga-Caspian route in search of trade with Persia.

During the Ottoman occupation of Shirvan in the late sixteenth century, vessels were built at Niyazabad for service on the Caspian. The port offered a route across the sea towards Central Asia at a time when Russian fortresses obstructed northern land approaches. Silk from Shirvan was among the commodities sought by merchants moving along these routes, joining the coastal town to a network stretching from Iran to Russia and beyond.
simp_chinese:
尼亚扎巴德是希尔凡位于里海西岸的港口，处在巴库与德尔本特之间。船舶和商队将它与内陆的沙马基市场及对岸港口连接起来。欧洲旅行家与外交使节沿伏尔加河—里海路线寻找同波斯贸易的机会，他们的记述中也出现了这座港口。

十六世纪末奥斯曼占领希尔凡期间，尼亚扎巴德建造船只供里海使用。俄国堡垒阻碍北方陆路之际，港口提供了横渡里海前往中亚的路线。希尔凡丝绸是商人在这些道路上寻求的货物之一，沿海城镇因而与从伊朗延伸至俄国乃至更远处的贸易网络相连。

english: Off north-eastern Sakhalin, the coast is lined with shallow lagoons behind narrow sand spits. Nyysky Bay and Nabilsky Bay are among these sheltered waters, opening to the Sea of Okhotsk through coastal channels. The Tym, Sakhalin's largest river, reaches the sea along the same northern coast.
simp_chinese: 库页岛东北岸外，狭长沙嘴后排列着一连串浅泻湖。尼斯基湾和纳比利湾是其中两片较为隐蔽的水域，经海岸水道与鄂霍次克海相通。库页岛最大的河流特米河也在这一北部海岸入海。

english: Nizhelskoye belongs to the wooded lake country south of Toropets, within the basin of the Western Dvina. A district called Nezhelskaya was listed among the Toropets lands in Ivan IV's testament of 1572. Its lakes and small rivers lay between the old town and the Dvina, amid villages scattered across the forested uplands. The waterways connected this countryside with the wider network leading west toward the Baltic.
simp_chinese: 尼热尔斯科耶属于托罗佩茨以南森林覆盖的湖区，位于西德维纳河流域。伊凡四世1572年的遗嘱将名为涅热尔斯卡娅的乡区列入托罗佩茨领地。湖泊与小河位于古城和德维纳河之间，村庄散布在林木高地上。水道将这片乡村与向西通往波罗的海的广阔网络相连。

english:
Nizhnekolymsk belongs to the lower Kolyma country of northeastern Siberia, where a major river provided access through tundra and forest-tundra toward the Arctic coast. Fishing and hunting supported local communities, while seasonal movement allowed resources to be used across a wide territory. Boats were useful during the short open-water season, and winter travel followed frozen ground and river ice. Severe cold and distance made supplies and reliable route knowledge essential.

Russian Cossacks established a winter post on the lower Kolyma in the 1640s. Omok Yukaghirs attacked the post, and it later received a wooden palisade. Repeated flooding led to the settlement's relocation farther south in the 1750s or 1760s. Indigenous resistance, fur trade and the difficulty of communication shaped the post's changing fortunes on the imperial frontier.
simp_chinese:
下科雷姆斯克属于西伯利亚东北科雷马河下游，大河提供穿过苔原和森林苔原、通向北极海岸的道路。捕鱼与狩猎支撑地方社区，季节移动让居民利用广大区域资源。短暂无冰季节使用舟船，冬季则沿冻结地面和河冰旅行。严寒与距离使补给和可靠道路知识尤其重要，外来者同样必须适应这些条件。

俄国哥萨克在1640年代于科雷马河下游建立越冬据点。奥莫克尤卡吉尔人曾进攻该据点，后来这里加筑了木栅。反复洪水导致聚落在1750或1760年代向南迁移。原住民抵抗、毛皮贸易与通信困难，共同影响了帝国边疆据点的兴衰。

english:
Nizhneudinsk belongs to the Uda river country of southern Siberia, where valleys and forested uplands connect the Yenisei approaches with routes towards Irkutsk. Agriculture occupies suitable land, while fishing, hunting and woodland resources supplement household production. Rivers and overland paths provide movement through difficult terrain, making reliable supplies and local knowledge important. The settlement's position gives it a role within a transport network much larger than its immediate surroundings.

In 1648 the Cossack leader Yelisey Tyumentsev founded a Russian wintering post on the Uda. By 1664 it was known as the Pokrovsky or Uda ostrog, a fortified settlement later rebuilt more than once. In the eighteenth century the Moscow road passed nearby and a postal station was established. The settlement received its present name and town status in 1783, according to the Great Russian Encyclopedia.
simp_chinese:
下乌金斯克属于西伯利亚南部乌达河地区，河谷和森林高地把叶尼塞方向同伊尔库茨克路线连接。适宜土地用于农业，捕鱼、狩猎和林地资源补充家庭生产。河流与陆路穿越困难地形，使可靠补给及地方知识十分重要。聚落位置使其参与范围远超周边的运输网络。

1648年，哥萨克首领叶利谢伊·秋缅采夫在乌达河畔建立俄国越冬据点。到1664年，它被称为波克罗夫斯基或乌丁斯克木栅堡，此后多次重建。十八世纪，莫斯科大路经过附近，当地设立了驿站。据《俄罗斯大百科全书》记载，聚落于1783年取得城市地位并采用现名。

english: Nizhny Chir takes its name from the lower Chir, a tributary joining the Don in the steppe. The Cossack town of Chir is mentioned in 1593, while the stanitsa of Nizhne-Chirskaya traces its foundation to 1637. Its position brought together the river communities of the Don and the Chir. As the Don Host's settlements grew, the stanitsa became a centre for the surrounding Cossack district, whose people combined service with farming and stock raising.
simp_chinese: 下奇尔得名于草原上汇入顿河的奇尔河下游。奇尔哥萨克城镇见于1593年的记载，而下奇尔斯卡亚村社将其建立年代追溯至1637年。这里的位置使顿河与奇尔河的河畔社区相互联系。随着顿河军团聚落发展，村社成为周围哥萨克地区的中心，居民在服役之余从事耕种和畜牧。

english: Nizhny Lomov grew beside the Lomovka as a fortified town on the southern frontier of the Russian state. Founded in 1635 by order of Tsar Michael, its wooden fort formed part of a defensive line against raids from the steppe. The town endured attacks and was captured by forces associated with Stenka Razin's uprising in 1670. Later, as the frontier moved southward, its markets gained importance on routes carrying goods toward the great fair at Nizhny Novgorod.
simp_chinese: 下洛莫夫兴起于洛莫夫卡河畔，原是俄罗斯国家南方边境的一座设防城镇。1635年，米哈伊尔沙皇下令在此建造木堡，作为抵御草原袭击的防线一部分。城镇曾遭多次进攻，1670年被与斯捷潘·拉辛起义相关的军队占领。后来随着边境南移，当地市场在通往下诺夫哥罗德大集市的商路上日益重要。

english:
Nizhny Novgorod stands on a high bluff above the meeting of the Oka and the Volga. Prince Yuri Vsevolodovich of Vladimir founded it in 1221 as a border fortress against the Mordvins and the Volga Bulgars, and it remained the easternmost Russian town until 1372. In 1350 it became the capital of the Suzdal–Nizhny Novgorod principality, a rival of Moscow, under Prince Dmitry Konstantinovich. In 1374 Dmitry began a white-stone kremlin to replace the earthen walls, but money and politics left it unfinished. Moscow annexed the principality in 1392, and the former princes moved to the Muscovite court as the Shuisky family.

The Tatar chieftain Edigu burned Nizhny in 1408, yet Muscovy came to see it chiefly as the great stronghold against Kazan. The red-brick kremlin, begun in 1500 and completed in the 1510s, was never taken by an enemy. In 1612 the town elder Kuzma Minin raised money and men under its walls, and with Prince Dmitry Pozharsky led the militia that freed Moscow. After the church schism, Old Believers settled along the Kerzhenets river nearby, and a diocese was founded in 1672 to counter them. Peter I made Nizhny the seat of a governorate in 1714, and in 1817 the great Makaryev Fair was moved here from Makaryev.
simp_chinese:
下诺夫哥罗德位于奥卡河汇入伏尔加河处的高崖之上。1221年，弗拉基米尔大公尤里·弗谢沃洛多维奇把它建成防备莫尔多瓦人与伏尔加保加尔人的边境要塞，直到1372年之前它一直是最东面的罗斯城镇。1350年，它成为苏兹达尔—下诺夫哥罗德公国的都城，在德米特里·康斯坦丁诺维奇公爵治下与莫斯科抗衡。1374年，德米特里开始用白石修建克里姆林，取代原来的土垒，但因资金和政局所限而未完成。1392年莫斯科吞并公国，旧日诸公迁往莫斯科宫廷，成为舒伊斯基家族。

鞑靼首领埃迪古于1408年焚毁下诺夫哥罗德，但莫斯科国逐渐把它主要看作对抗喀山的大据点。红砖克里姆林始建于1500年，在1510年代完工，从未被敌人攻陷。1612年，市镇长老库济马·米宁在它的城墙下筹款募兵，与德米特里·波扎尔斯基公爵率民兵解放了莫斯科。教会分裂后，旧礼仪派信徒在附近的克尔热涅茨河沿岸定居，1672年为对付他们设立了教区。1714年，彼得一世把下诺夫哥罗德定为一省的治所；1817年，著名的马卡里耶夫集市从马卡里耶夫迁到此地。

english:
Nizhny Tagil grew around the Demidov family's metallurgical works in the Urals. Ore discoveries near Mount Vysokaya and the Vyya River at the turn of the eighteenth century drew attention to the district. The Vyya works produced its first pig iron in 1722, a date taken as the settlement's foundation; the Nizhny Tagil works followed with its first pig iron in 1725. Iron and copper from the Demidov enterprises became known under the Old Sable mark.

Mines and works were organized into the Nizhny Tagil industrial district in 1807. Alongside metallurgy, local crafts included the painted metal trays for which Tagil became renowned. The serf mechanics Yefim and Miron Cherepanov, father and son, built early Russian steam locomotives here in the 1830s. Their work grew out of the technical demands of the mining district, where furnaces, workshops and transport linked the ore deposits to the factory settlements.
simp_chinese:
下塔吉尔围绕乌拉尔的杰米多夫家族冶金厂发展起来。十八世纪前后，维索卡亚山和维亚河附近发现矿石，引起人们对这一地区的注意。1722年，维亚厂产出第一批生铁，这一年被视为聚落的建立日期；下塔吉尔厂于1725年炼出第一批生铁。杰米多夫企业生产的铁和铜以“老紫貂”商标闻名。

1807年，矿场和工厂被编入下塔吉尔矿业工业区。除冶金外，当地手工业还包括著名的塔吉尔彩绘金属托盘。1830年代，农奴机械师叶菲姆和米龙·切列潘诺夫父子在此建造了俄罗斯早期蒸汽机车。他们的工作源于矿业区的技术需求：高炉、工坊和运输将矿藏与厂区聚落联系起来。

english: Nizhnyaya Salda arose in 1758 when construction began on Nikita Demidov's ironworks on the Salda River. The factory settlement occupied a landscape previously inhabited by the indigenous Mansi. Workers brought to the Urals from other Russian provinces practiced household crafts as well as serving the works: they made birch-bark containers, bast shoes and clay vessels, and kept cattle and horses. The Demidovs later funded a stone Church of Saint Nicholas, begun in 1826.
simp_chinese: 下萨尔达兴起于1758年，当时尼基塔·杰米多夫在萨尔达河上开始建造炼铁厂。厂区聚落所在的土地此前有原住民曼西人居住。从俄罗斯其他省份带到乌拉尔的工人除服务工厂外，还经营家庭手工业：他们制作桦树皮容器、树皮鞋和陶器，并饲养牛马。杰米多夫家族后来出资建造圣尼古拉石教堂，工程始于1826年。

english: The Lower Toyma rises on the watershed between the Pinega and Northern Dvina and flows westward through the northern forests to join the Dvina from the right. A group of riverside villages at its mouth shares the name of the river. Together with the Upper Toyma farther upstream, the Lower Toyma gave its name to a district of the Dvina lands, whose waterways linked the forest settlements to the great river flowing north towards the White Sea.
simp_chinese: 下托伊马河发源于皮涅加河与北德维纳河之间的分水岭，向西流经北方森林，从右岸汇入北德维纳河。河口一组沿河村庄也以这条河命名。下托伊马与上游的上托伊马一起，为德维纳河地区的地方区域留下了名称；这里的水道将森林聚落与流向白海的大河联系起来。

english:
Nizhyn stands on the Oster, northeast of Kyiv, at a meeting of routes through the Severian lands. Known in the twelfth century as Unenezh, it was restored after medieval destruction and grew into a major town of the Cossack Hetmanate. Its fairs and Greek merchants made it one of the leading commercial centres of left-bank Ukraine.

Under Polish-Lithuanian rule Nizhyn received Magdeburg rights in 1625. From 1648 it was the seat of the Nizhyn regiment, a military and administrative unit of the Hetmanate. In 1663 a general Cossack assembly known as the Black Council met near the town and elected Ivan Briukhovetsky hetman of the Left Bank. The decision formed part of the bitter struggles dividing Cossack Ukraine. Greek merchants enjoyed privileges confirmed by Bohdan Khmelnytsky and Ivan Mazepa, established a brotherhood in 1687, and later governed their community through a separate magistrate. Nizhyn's great fair attracted traders to the town. In 1805 the Bezborodko Lyceum was founded, adding an important school to its commercial and cultural life.
simp_chinese:
涅任位于基辅东北方的奥斯捷尔河畔，谢韦里亚诸地的道路在此交汇。十二世纪它以乌涅涅日之名见于记载，中世纪遭破坏后得以恢复，并发展为哥萨克酋长国的重要城镇。集市和希腊商人使它成为左岸乌克兰主要的贸易中心之一。

波兰立陶宛统治下，涅任于1625年获得马格德堡法权。1648年起，它是涅任哥萨克团的驻地，该团兼具军事和地方行政职能。1663年，一次被称为“黑色议会”的哥萨克大会在城镇附近举行，选出伊万·布留霍韦茨基为左岸盖特曼。这一决定是分裂哥萨克乌克兰的激烈争斗的一部分。希腊商人的特权得到博赫丹·赫梅利尼茨基和伊万·马泽帕确认；他们于1687年建立兄弟会，后来通过独立的市政机构管理社群。涅任的大集吸引各地商人。1805年，别兹博罗德科中学成立，为城镇的商业和文化生活增添了一所重要学府。

english:
Nizwa lies in the interior of Oman, where oasis agriculture depends on aflaj irrigation channels. It was a centre of Ibadi religious learning and at various times the seat of an imam, linking the surrounding valleys to the political life of Oman. Falaj Daris, one of the region's notable channels, carries water for cultivation.

In the mid-seventeenth century Imam Sultan bin Saif of the Ya'ruba dynasty built the great circular fort at Nizwa. The fort served as a residence and seat of local government as well as a defensive structure. Its construction belonged to a period in which the Ya'ruba imams consolidated authority and challenged Portuguese positions on the Omani coast.
simp_chinese:
奈兹瓦位于阿曼内陆，绿洲农业依靠阿夫拉吉灌溉水渠。它是伊巴德派宗教学术中心，也曾在不同时期作为伊玛目的驻地，将周围河谷与阿曼的政治生活联系起来。达里斯水渠是当地著名的灌溉渠道之一。

17世纪中叶，叶阿里巴王朝的伊玛目苏丹·本·赛义夫在奈兹瓦修建大型圆形堡垒。堡垒既是居所和地方政府所在地，也承担防御职能。它建于叶阿里巴伊玛目巩固权威、挑战阿曼海岸葡萄牙据点的时期。

english: Njamara is a stone-walled centre high in the mountains of Barue, east of the Zimbabwean plateau. Its enclosures occupy different parts of the summit, with the remains of clay-plastered dwellings inside the walls. The buildings belong to the Zimbabwe tradition that extended across the highlands into the eastern country. Other stone-built places, including nearby Magure, mark a landscape of local centres linked by shared techniques and traditions of authority.
simp_chinese: 恩贾马拉是一处石墙中心，位于津巴布韦高原以东巴鲁埃的高山之上。围墙分布在山顶不同部分，其中保留着泥饰房屋的遗迹。这里的建筑属于从高原延伸至东部地区的津巴布韦传统。附近的马古雷等其他石建地点，共同构成一片地方中心相连的地域，其间共享建筑技艺与权威传统。

sources.title: elizabeth macgonagle crafting identity in zimbabbook4me.org .pdf

english: Njambi lies near Cameia in the upper Zambezi basin. The Cameia country combines miombo woodland with seasonally flooded savanna and marshes. Its rivers include the Zambezi and Luena, while lakes and grasslands retain water across the flat, sandy landscape during the rains.
simp_chinese: 恩詹比靠近卡梅亚，位于赞比西河上游流域。卡梅亚地区的米翁博林地与季节性泛滥的稀树草原、沼泽交错。这里的河流包括赞比西河和卢埃纳河，雨季时平坦沙地上的湖泊与草地也蓄留着水。

english: Ngazidja, the largest of the Comoro Islands, rises from the waters between East Africa and Madagascar. Its volcanic rock absorbs much of the rain, leaving few permanent streams, and its rocky shore offers little shelter to large vessels. Ships passing through the Mozambique Channel often followed the African coast and sighted the island's western shore. Smaller Swahili craft and ocean-going canoes connected the Comoros with their neighbours despite these difficult approaches.
simp_chinese: 恩加济贾是科摩罗群岛中最大的岛屿，从东非与马达加斯加之间的海水中升起。火山岩吸收大量雨水，岛上常年河流稀少；岩石海岸也难以为大船提供避风处。穿越莫桑比克海峡的船只常沿非洲海岸航行，望见岛屿西岸。尽管靠岸困难，较小的斯瓦希里船只和远航独木舟仍将科摩罗与邻近地区联系起来。

english:
Njimi was the capital of Kanem east of Lake Chad, the seat of the Duguwa and then the Sayfawa mais, and probably the first capital of the empire. Al-Idrisi mentioned it in the twelfth century as a smaller town south of Manan, and later writers described it as the home of the mai. It stood on the trans-Saharan routes that joined the Chad basin with North Africa.

The Bilala, who had been part of the empire, rebelled against the mais, and around 1380 they drove the Sayfawa from Kanem and took Njimi. Mai Umar I Idrismi moved the empire across the lake to Bornu. For about a century the court had no permanent capital, until Ali I Gaji founded Ngazargamu on the Yobe River around 1472. Ali's son Idris III Katagarmabe retook Kanem in the early sixteenth century, but the imperial centre stayed in Bornu. Njimi was still a prominent place in the sixteenth century, though its old medieval buildings had been abandoned.
simp_chinese:
恩吉米是乍得湖以东加奈姆的都城，是杜古瓦王朝和赛法瓦王朝迈（国王）的治所，很可能也是帝国的第一座都城。12世纪的伊德里西把它记作马南以南的一座较小城镇，后来的作者则称之为迈的驻地。它位于连接乍得盆地与北非的跨撒哈拉商路上。

原属帝国的比拉拉人起兵反抗迈，约1380年将赛法瓦赶出加奈姆，占领了恩吉米。迈乌马尔一世·伊德里斯米把帝国迁到湖西的博尔努。此后约一个世纪里宫廷没有固定都城，直到阿里一世·加吉约在1472年于约贝河畔建起恩加扎尔加穆。阿里之子伊德里斯三世·卡塔加尔马贝在16世纪初夺回加奈姆，但帝国中心仍留在博尔努。恩吉米在16世纪仍是显要之地，只是古老的中世纪建筑已被废弃。

english: Njoko lies in the country east of the upper Zambezi, among streams including the Njoko, Nangombe and Lumbe. To the west the great river passes through the Barotse floodplain and over Ngonye Falls. Its seasonal waters shape a landscape of low ground and river channels, while the smaller streams drain the country on the eastern side.
simp_chinese: 恩乔科位于上赞比西河以东，附近有恩乔科河、南贡贝河和伦贝河等水道。西面的大河穿过巴罗策泛滥平原，流经恩戈涅瀑布。河水随季节涨落，塑造出低地与水道交错的景观，较小的溪流则汇集东侧土地上的水。

english: The Nkam flows from the western highlands through the forest country of Cameroon. It meets the Makombé above Yabassi, and together their waters form the Wouri, which reaches the Gulf of Guinea. Dense vegetation covers the valleys and slopes along the upper river. Canoes carry people along the Nkam between riverside settlements, while its tributaries drain the wooded country between the high plateau and the coastal plain.
simp_chinese: 恩卡姆河从西部高地流出，穿过喀麦隆的森林地带，在亚巴西上游与马孔贝河汇合，形成注入几内亚湾的伍里河。上游河谷与山坡覆盖着茂密植被。独木舟沿恩卡姆河往来于河畔聚落之间，支流则汇集高原与沿海平原之间林地的水流。

english: Nkambé lies on a grassy plateau cut by wooded ravines in the Cameroon highlands. The Wimbum, speakers of Limbum, are thought to have reached this country between the eighteenth and mid-nineteenth centuries. Their villages belonged to three broad clan groupings, Warr, Tang, and Wiya. The country saw some ivory trade but lay away from the principal long-distance routes, and its communities faced raids for captives.
simp_chinese: 恩坎贝位于喀麦隆高地的一片草原台地上，林木茂密的沟壑切穿其间。讲林布姆语的温布姆人据信在18世纪至19世纪中叶之间抵达此地，他们的村落分属瓦尔、唐和维亚三个大的氏族群体。这里有象牙交易，但远离主要长途商路，当地社群也面临掳人奴役的袭击。

english: The Nkankezi is a river of the Mzingwane basin, crossing the gold-bearing country of the southern Zimbabwean plateau. Its flow is seasonal, and its valley lies among the rivers and mineral deposits of the Insiza region. To the east, the stone-walled centre of Chumnungwa flourished in the gold-rich Mberengwa country, where its inhabitants worked local iron and soapstone as well as gold and maintained connections with other communities across the plateau.
simp_chinese: 恩坎克兹河属于姆津瓜内河流域，流经津巴布韦南部高原的产金地区。它的水流随季节变化，河谷与因西扎地区的其他河流、矿藏相伴。东面的姆贝伦瓜同样富产黄金，石墙环绕的楚姆农瓜中心曾在那里兴盛；居民除加工本地黄金外，也利用铁和皂石，并与高原各地的社群保持联系。

english: Nkata lies west of Ngoma in the Kafue country, where sandy soils support open miombo woodland. Small dambos interrupt the woodland, while the Nkala stream near Ngoma dries in the dry season and spreads across the plain after rains. Farther east the Kafue flows towards its broad floodplain.
simp_chinese: 恩卡塔位于恩戈马以西的卡富埃地区，沙土上生长着开阔的米翁博林地。林地间散布着小片浅湿地；恩戈马附近的恩卡拉溪在旱季干涸，雨后则漫过平原。更东面的卡富埃河流向其宽广的洪泛平原。

english: Grand Coulee is a vast, steep-sided channel cut into the basalt of the Columbia Plateau. During the last ice age, floods swept across this country when ice blocked the Columbia River, carving the great chasm and the cliffs of Dry Falls. After the ice retreated, the Columbia returned to its old course. Lakes such as Lenore and Soap Lake remain in the lower coulee below the former waterfall.
simp_chinese: 大古利是切入哥伦比亚高原玄武岩的一条巨大陡壁沟谷。上一次冰期，冰川堵住哥伦比亚河，洪水横扫这一地区，刻出深谷与干瀑布的峭壁。冰川消退后，哥伦比亚河重新流回旧河道；莱诺尔湖和肥皂湖等湖泊留在昔日瀑布下方的低谷中。

english: Nkunga lies in the Kongo country near Mbanza Kongo, the royal capital set on a hill above the Luezi valley. The surrounding lands formed part of a kingdom whose provincial chiefs and royal court governed communities across the lower Congo region. Kongo traditions endured alongside Christianity, which became established at the court after Portuguese contact in the late fifteenth century.
simp_chinese: 恩昆加位于姆班扎刚果附近，处于刚果人的土地上。王都坐落在卢埃济河谷上方的山丘，其周围地区属于刚果王国；王庭与各省首领共同统治下刚果一带的社群。十五世纪末与葡萄牙接触之后，基督教在王庭扎根，但刚果的传统仍与之并存。

english: The Nlaka'pamux homeland encompasses the canyons and valleys where the Thompson River joins the Fraser. Salmon fisheries along these rivers were central to the lives of interior communities, drawing people to fishing grounds in season. In 1808 the fur trader Simon Fraser descended the river with Indigenous guides and met Nlaka'pamux people near the confluence, where their oral history remembers a difficult encounter with the visitors.
simp_chinese: 恩拉卡帕穆克斯人的家园包括汤普森河与弗雷泽河交会处的峡谷和河谷。两河的鲑鱼渔场是内陆社群生活的核心，鱼汛时吸引人们前来捕捞。1808年，毛皮商人西蒙·弗雷泽在原住民向导陪同下顺河而下，在两河交会附近遇见恩拉卡帕穆克斯人；他们的口述历史记下了这场并不愉快的相遇。

sources.title: simon fraser explores fraser river and meets indians at lytton

english: Nme'juaqnek lies beside the tidal waters of the Annapolis River, a place long inhabited by the Mi'kmaq. French settlers established Port-Royal in the region in the early seventeenth century, and the river became a center of Acadian settlement. The fort at Annapolis Royal changed hands repeatedly as France and Britain fought for control of Acadia. After the British capture of 1710, the settlement remained a focal point of the struggle over the peninsula and its inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 内梅朱阿克内克位于安纳波利斯河的潮汐水域旁，是米克马克人长期居住的地方。十七世纪初，法国人在这一地区建立皇家港，河谷后来成为阿卡迪亚聚居中心。法国与英国争夺阿卡迪亚期间，安纳波利斯皇家港的堡垒多次易手。1710年英国人占领之后，这里仍是围绕半岛及其居民的争夺焦点。

english: Nnewi is an Igbo town east of the Niger, traditionally composed of four communities: Otolo, Uruagu, Umudim and Nnewichi. Each has its own Obi, while the ruler of Otolo holds senior standing among them. Local traditions trace the kingdom’s formation to ancestral lineages whose histories do not always agree in detail. Farming, exchange and ties among the communities sustained the town’s place in the wider Igbo country.
simp_chinese: 恩内维是尼日尔河以东的伊博城镇，传统上由奥托洛、乌鲁阿古、乌穆迪姆和恩内维奇四个社群组成。各社群都有自己的奥比，奥托洛的统治者则居于首位。当地传统将王国的形成追溯至祖先宗族，但不同记述的细节并不完全一致。农业、交换和社群间的联系维系着城镇在更广大伊博地区中的地位。

english: Nǁng, also known as Nǀuu, is a language of the southern Kalahari, traditionally spoken by the ǂKhomani San. Its many click consonants belong to a linguistic heritage shared with related Tuu languages of southern Africa. In the sandy country around the Nossob and Auob, the ǂKhomani and their neighbours hunted and gathered among dunes and dry riverbeds. Their knowledge of plants, animals and water made it possible to live in a land of scarce rain.
simp_chinese: 恩恩语又称努语，是卡拉哈里南部的一门语言，传统上由ǂ科马尼桑人使用。语言中丰富的搭嘴辅音，与南部非洲其他图语系语言拥有共同渊源。在诺索布河和奥奥布河周围的沙地，ǂ科马尼人及其邻居在沙丘和干河床之间狩猎采集。他们熟悉植物、动物和水源，得以在少雨的土地上生活。

english: The Nǁnǂe, also known as the ǂKhomani, are San people of the southern Kalahari. Their language Nǁng, or Nǀuu, belongs to the Tuu family and has an extensive range of click consonants. In the sandy country of the Nossob and Auob riverbeds, ǂKhomani knowledge of plants and animals includes the use of wild melons and tubers as sources of moisture when surface water is scarce.
simp_chinese: 恩恩克又称科马尼，是卡拉哈里南部的桑人。他们使用的恩恩语又称努语，属于图语系，有丰富的搭嘴辅音。在诺索布河与奥阿布河干河床附近的沙地，科马尼人熟悉当地动植物；地表水稀少时，野生瓜果和块茎可以提供水分。

english: The Noa-Dihing descends from the Patkai hills towards the upper Brahmaputra valley. The river country formed part of the route by which the Ahoms entered Assam from the east in the early thirteenth century. Crossing the Patkai through the Pangsau Pass, they advanced along the Noa-Dihing before establishing their kingdom farther west. Forested hills rise above the river, which joins the wider network of waters feeding the Brahmaputra.
simp_chinese: 诺阿迪兴河从帕特凯山地流向布拉姆普特拉河上游谷地。十三世纪初，阿洪人从东方进入阿萨姆时，河谷地区是其路线的一部分。他们经邦绍山口越过帕特凯山，沿诺阿迪兴河推进，随后在更西方建立王国。森林山岭高出河谷，河水最终汇入哺育布拉姆普特拉河的水系。

english: Noanamá is a name associated with the Wounaan people of the San Juan River in Colombia’s Pacific lowlands. Their communities have lived along the middle and lower river for centuries, travelling its waters through dense rainforest. Spanish expeditions encountered the Noanamá in the sixteenth century; the lower river was known by their name before the name San Juan came into use. Fishing and forest resources supported life along its banks.
simp_chinese: 诺阿纳马是与哥伦比亚太平洋低地圣胡安河沃纳安人有关的名称。他们的社群数百年来居住在河流中下游，沿水道穿过茂密雨林。十六世纪西班牙远征队遇见诺阿纳马人；在圣胡安之名通行以前，河流下游曾以他们的名称命名。鱼产与森林资源维持着沿岸生活。

english: Noanamaronga is a name used by the neighbouring Martuthunira for the Nhuwala people of the Pilbara. The Nhuwala are one of the Aboriginal peoples of this dry part of Western Australia. Their country belongs to a landscape of plains, rocky country and watercourses, within a region whose neighbouring communities maintained distinct languages and identities.
simp_chinese: 诺阿纳马龙加是邻近的马图图尼拉人对皮尔巴拉努瓦拉人的称呼。努瓦拉人是西澳大利亚这一干旱地区的原住民族群之一。其土地处于平原、岩地与水道交错的地区；这里的相邻社群各有自己的语言与身份。

english: The Noatak River winds west through a vast basin enclosed by the mountains of the Brooks Range. Permafrost underlies much of the valley, and the river cuts through a long canyon before reaching the coastal lowlands. This is the homeland of the Nuataaġmiut Iñupiat, whose history in the basin reaches back thousands of years. Archaeological sites along the river and its tributaries bear witness to generations of people who hunted and travelled in the mountain-ringed country. The river joins the interior to the shores of Kotzebue Sound.
simp_chinese: 诺阿塔克河向西蜿蜒流过广阔盆地，周围为布鲁克斯山脉群山所环绕。谷地大部分地下有永久冻土，河流切穿长长的峡谷，最终抵达沿海低地。这里是努塔阿格缪特因纽皮亚特人的家园，他们在盆地生活的历史可追溯数千年。河流与支流沿岸的考古遗址见证了一代代人在群山环绕的土地上狩猎和旅行。河流将内陆与科策布湾沿岸相连。

english: Nobel occupies a peninsula on the lake of the same name in the Pripyat valley. Known in medieval chronicles as Nebl, it was a centre of the watery borderlands of Polesia. In the sixteenth century its monastery and churches made it a religious centre; a manuscript Gospel was completed for St Nicholas's Church in 1520. A privilege issued in 1524 allowed the monastery's monks to fish in the lake and the Pripyat.
simp_chinese: 诺贝尔位于普里皮亚季河谷同名湖泊中的半岛上。中世纪编年史称此地为涅布利，它曾是波列西亚多水边地的一处中心。十六世纪，这里的修道院和教堂使它成为宗教中心；1520年，当地人为圣尼古拉教堂抄成一部手抄福音书。1524年颁发的特权允许修士在湖中及普里皮亚季河捕鱼。

english: This coast belongs to the central Kuril island chain, which separates the Sea of Okhotsk from the Pacific. Fog often hides the shores, though volcanic summits may remain visible above it. Dense kelp beds grow in the shallows around the islands. In spring, drift ice moves along the Okhotsk side and may pass through the straits into the Pacific, where the cold Oyashio current carries it southward.
simp_chinese: 这片海岸属于千岛中部岛链，岛屿分隔鄂霍次克海与太平洋。浓雾常遮住海岸，火山山顶却可能仍露在雾上。岛屿附近浅水区生长着密集的昆布。春季，流冰沿鄂霍次克海一侧漂移，有时穿过海峡进入太平洋，再被寒冷的亲潮带向南方。

english: Nochemoweniing, the “place of healing”, lies on the eastern shore of the peninsula between Lake Huron and Georgian Bay. Its wooded heights and limestone shores belong to the long homeland of the Saugeen Ojibway. The peninsula was a spiritual destination for people from across the Great Lakes, and traditions remember this bay as a place to which people travelled for healing. The waters on either side connect it with the islands and shores of the wider lake country.
simp_chinese: 诺切莫韦宁意为“疗愈之地”，位于休伦湖与乔治亚湾之间半岛的东岸。森林高地与石灰岩岸边是索金奥吉布瓦人的长久家园。半岛是五大湖各地人们前往的精神之地；传统记忆中，人们来到这处海湾寻求疗愈。两侧水域将它与广大湖区的岛屿和海岸连接起来。

english:
Nochistlán lies among the hills of southern Zacatecas, in a region once inhabited by the Caxcan. Its rocky heights and valleys became a center of Indigenous resistance during the Spanish conquest of Nueva Galicia. In 1532 the Spaniards founded the first settlement named Guadalajara nearby, but Caxcan opposition helped drive them to move it to Tonalá the following year.

In 1541 the Mixtón War spread through Nochistlán, Juchipila, Jalpa and neighboring towns. The Caxcan leader Tenamaxtli and other commanders defended the rocky height near Nochistlán against a Spanish force led by Pedro de Alvarado. Their resistance defeated the attack, and Alvarado was fatally injured during the campaign. Viceroy Antonio de Mendoza later assembled a much larger army of Spaniards and Indigenous allies to suppress the rebellion. Nochistlán remained a place closely associated with the struggle over Nueva Galicia.
simp_chinese:
诺奇斯特兰位于萨卡特卡斯南部丘陵之间，属于卡斯坎人曾经居住的地区。西班牙征服新加利西亚时，附近岩山和谷地成为原住民抵抗的中心。1532年，西班牙人在附近建立首个名为瓜达拉哈拉的聚落；卡斯坎人的反抗促使他们次年将其迁往托纳拉。

1541年，米斯通战争蔓延至诺奇斯特兰、胡奇皮拉、哈尔帕和邻近城镇。卡斯坎首领特纳马斯特利与其他领袖共同防守诺奇斯特兰附近的岩山，抵抗佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多率领的西班牙军队。他们击退了进攻，阿尔瓦拉多在战役中受致命伤。总督安东尼奥·德·门多萨后来集结规模大得多的西班牙军队及原住民盟军，镇压这场起义。诺奇斯特兰因此与新加利西亚的争夺紧密相连。

english: Nochixtlán lies in a valley of the Mixteca Alta, a region of hills and interconnected Mixtec communities in Oaxaca. Its name appears in pictorial manuscripts associated with the cochineal-producing country of the valley. Nearby Jaltepec was an important Mixtec political centre, whose rulers’ history was recorded in the Codex Selden. These painted histories preserve relationships between local dynasties and places across the highlands.
simp_chinese: 诺奇什特兰位于瓦哈卡米斯特卡阿尔塔的山谷中，周围是丘陵与彼此相连的米斯特克社群。它的名称出现在图绘手抄本里，与谷地产胭脂虫的地区相联系。附近的哈尔特佩克是重要的米斯特克政治中心，其统治者历史记录在《塞尔登手抄本》中。这些绘史保存了高地各地方王朝与地点之间的关系。

english:
The Nochpeem were a people of the Hudson Highlands, their villages lying east of the river among wooded hills and valleys. They belonged to the wider Wappinger group of communities whose lands extended along the Hudson. The Canopus group lived in the country around Putnam Valley, while other Nochpeem homes stood near the river north of Anthony's Nose.

In the 1640s, war between the Dutch colony of New Netherland and neighboring Indigenous communities brought violence to the lower Hudson. In April 1644 representatives of the Nochpeem and other groups sought help from the English at Stamford during the conflict. The Dutch eventually made peace with Wappinger representatives in 1645, but colonial land claims continued to press upon the peoples of the valley.
simp_chinese:
诺奇皮姆人生活在哈得孙高地，村庄散布于河流东岸的林木丘陵和谷地之间。他们属于更广泛的瓦平格社群，其土地沿哈得孙河延伸。卡诺普斯支群居住在帕特南县谷地一带，另有诺奇皮姆人的居所位于安东尼鼻山以北的河边。

十七世纪四十年代，荷兰殖民地新尼德兰与邻近原住民社群的战争给哈得孙河下游带来暴力。1644年四月，诺奇皮姆人及其他群体的代表在冲突中前往斯坦福，向英国人寻求帮助。荷兰人最终于1645年与瓦平格代表议和，但殖民者的土地声索继续给河谷各族带来压力。

english: Nochu-chi was a Southern Sierra Miwok village in the country near Mariposa, on the western slopes of the Sierra Nevada. The Sierra Miwok homeland extended across the mountains and foothills between the Fresno and Cosumnes Rivers. Its inhabitants lived in small local communities, hunting and gathering rather than relying on a single central authority. Their skilled basketry was among the crafts of a people whose languages and settlements varied across the mountain country.
simp_chinese: 诺丘奇是南内华达米沃克人的村庄，位于内华达山脉西坡马里波萨附近的地区。内华达米沃克人的故土横跨弗雷斯诺河与科苏姆内斯河之间的山地和山麓。居民以狩猎和采集为生，居于各自的地方社群，没有统一的中央权力。他们擅长编织篮器，而不同地区的村落和语言也各有特色。

english: The Nodaway River rises in southwestern Iowa and flows south through rolling prairie into Missouri, where it joins the Missouri River. Several branches gather water from the uplands before meeting the main river. Its valley forms a north–south route through a country of grassland and wooded streams. Near its mouth the Nodaway enters the broad floodplain of the Missouri, a great waterway connecting the northern Plains with the Mississippi.
simp_chinese: 诺德韦河发源于艾奥瓦西南部，向南流过起伏草原进入密苏里，汇入密苏里河。数条支流从高地汇集水流后加入干流。河谷在草原和林木溪流之间形成一条南北走向的通路。接近河口时，诺德韦河进入密苏里河宽阔的泛滥平原；这条大河将北部平原与密西西比河相连。

english: Nogamsig lies near the White Bear River in the rugged interior north of Newfoundland's south coast. To the south, White Bear Bay reaches inland past islands at its mouth. Bear Island, the easternmost and largest of them, shelters a small harbour, though submerged rocks make its entrance difficult.
simp_chinese: 诺加姆西格位于白熊河附近、纽芬兰南岸以北崎岖的内陆。南面的白熊湾从岛屿散布的湾口向内陆延伸。熊岛是其中最东、最大的岛屿，岛旁有一处避风小港，但入口处的暗礁令船只难以进入。

english:
Nogaro lies in Armagnac, within the rolling agricultural country of Gascony. Grain fields, vineyards, livestock, and local markets supported a town connected with surrounding villages and estates. Roads linked it with neighbouring centres and routes used by travellers across southwestern France. Religious institutions helped organise social life, while crafts and services brought rural produce and urban needs together. The area's mixed farming economy supplied resources through changing political conditions.

The collegiate church of Saint-Nicolas formed a centre of Nogaro's religious life. During the Wars of Religion, Protestant troops under Montgomery devastated the town in 1569, damaging the church's pillars and vaults. Nogaro recovered during the seventeenth century. Its history reflects both the institutions of a Gascon town and the impact of conflict on its buildings and inhabitants.
simp_chinese:
诺加罗位于阿马尼亚克，属于加斯科涅起伏农业地区。粮田、葡萄园、牲畜和地方市场，支持联系周围村庄、庄园的城镇。道路把它连接到邻近中心及法国西南旅行路线。宗教机构帮助组织社会生活，手工业和服务把乡村物产与城市需要汇合。混合农业经济在变化政治条件中持续提供资源。

圣尼古拉合议教堂是诺加罗宗教生活的中心。宗教战争期间，蒙哥马利率领的新教军队于1569年破坏城镇，教堂的柱子和拱顶也受损。诺加罗在十七世纪逐渐恢复，其历史既体现加斯科涅城镇的地方制度，也反映战争对建筑和居民的影响。

english: Nogent-sur-Seine grew beside a crossing of the Seine, where a castle mound and walls protected the town. During the Hundred Years' War, bands of soldiers ravaged the surrounding country. In 1359 a force led by Eustache d'Aubrecicourt was defeated near Nogent by troops fighting for the French regent. The bishop of Troyes, Henri de Poitiers, and armed townspeople came to their aid, and Aubrecicourt was taken prisoner. A local chapel came to be associated with the encounter.
simp_chinese: 塞纳河畔诺让发展于河流渡口旁，城堡土丘和城墙保护着镇子。百年战争期间，成群士兵劫掠周围乡野。1359年，效忠法国摄政的军队在诺让附近击败欧斯塔什·多布勒西库尔率领的部队。特鲁瓦主教亨利·德·普瓦捷和武装居民赶来支援，多布勒西库尔被俘。当地一座礼拜堂后来与这场战斗联系在一起。

english: The Nogolma were an indigenous community associated with the Conlara valley, west of the Sierra de Comechingones. Under Spanish rule, people bearing this name were recorded in a settlement on the Río Segundo, in the jurisdiction of Córdoba. By the late seventeenth century many had been moved to the estate of their encomendero in Calamuchita, while their community retained lands on the river. Colonial records also mention people displaced from the Calchaquí valleys among them.
simp_chinese: 诺戈尔马是与科梅钦戈内斯山脉以西孔拉拉河谷有关的原住民社群。西班牙统治下，科尔多瓦辖区的塞贡多河畔曾有一处以此为名的聚落。到十七世纪末，许多居民已被迁往监护领主在卡拉穆奇塔的庄园，但社群仍保有河畔土地。殖民记录还提到，社群中包括被迫离开卡尔查基河谷的人。

english: Nogoyá grew beside the stream of the same name in the rolling interior between the Paraná and Uruguay rivers. Settlers were present near a crossing by about 1760. In 1782 the priest Fernando Andrés Quiroga y Taboada established a chapel dedicated to Nuestra Señora del Carmen for the inhabitants, and a settlement developed around it. The stream gives its Indigenous name to the place and flows through the wider Gualeguay basin.
simp_chinese: 诺戈亚兴起于同名溪流旁，位于巴拉那河与乌拉圭河之间起伏的内陆。约1760年，渡口附近已有定居者。1782年，神父费尔南多·安德烈斯·基罗加·伊·塔沃阿达为居民建立卡门圣母小教堂，聚落随之在周围发展。溪流以原住民名称为当地命名，并流经更广阔的瓜莱瓜伊河流域。

english:
The castle of Nógrád stands on a hill above the northern Hungarian countryside. Its name, of Slavic origin, means a new castle, and it gave its name to the surrounding county. The stronghold belonged to the bishops of Vác, who maintained a residence there amid the hills north of the Danube.

Bishop Miklós Báthori rebuilt Nógrád at the end of the fifteenth century, adding Renaissance work to its medieval fortifications. The garrison abandoned it to the Ottomans in 1544, but Christian forces retook it fifty years later. Captured again in 1663, the castle was ruined when lightning struck its powder store in 1685. Its remaining defences were demolished during the Kuruc uprising in the early eighteenth century, leaving the hilltop castle in ruins.
simp_chinese:
诺格拉德城堡立于匈牙利北部乡间的山丘上。它的名字源于斯拉夫语，意为“新城堡”，周围的郡也由此得名。这座要塞属于瓦茨主教，主教们在多瑙河北方的丘陵间设有居所。

十五世纪末，主教巴托里·米克洛什重建了诺格拉德，在中世纪防御工事中加入文艺复兴风格的建筑。1544年，守军弃城，奥斯曼军队占领了它；五十年后，基督教军队将其夺回。1663年城堡再度失守，1685年雷击火药库，使其化为废墟。十八世纪初库鲁茨起义期间，残存的防御工事也被拆毁。

english: Pinda, also called Mpinda, was the port of Soyo near the mouth of the Congo River. It connected the kingdom of Kongo to Atlantic shipping, and its trade was subject to royal taxation. By the middle of the sixteenth century ships were carrying enslaved people from the port across the ocean. The Christian history of the region was also visible here: Capuchin missionaries later established a convent dedicated to Saint Anthony at Pinda.
simp_chinese: 平达又称姆平达，是刚果河口附近索约的港口。它将刚果王国与大西洋航运连接起来，贸易须向王室缴税。至十六世纪中叶，船只已从港口将被奴役的人运往大洋彼岸。这里也见证了当地的基督教历史：加布遣会传教士后来在平达建立了一座献给圣安多尼的修道院。

english: The Noguinet is a stream in the western Córdoba hills, near the valley of San Carlos Minas. It descends through a landscape of rugged slopes and narrow valleys, where watercourses carry rainfall from the mountains toward the drier lowlands. Indigenous communities inhabited the Córdoba ranges before Spanish settlement, cultivating crops in the valleys and producing pottery. The streams of the hills were vital features of this otherwise dry country.
simp_chinese: 诺吉内特是科尔多瓦西部山地的一条溪流，流经圣卡洛斯米纳斯山谷附近。溪流穿过崎岖山坡和狭窄谷地，将山中雨水带向较干燥的低地。西班牙人定居之前，原住民社群已经居住在科尔多瓦山脉，在谷地耕作并制作陶器。山间溪流是这片干燥地区的重要水源。

english: The Serebryanka drains the eastern Sikhote-Alin into a bay of the Sea of Japan. Its tributary the Zabolotochnaya descends from the mountains to join it, and coastal lakes lie near its lower course. The river's lower reach was formerly known as Sakhambe, while the upper waters bore the name Sitsa.
simp_chinese: 谢列布良卡河汇集锡霍特山脉东坡的水流，注入日本海的一处海湾。扎博洛琴纳亚河从山中流下汇入干流，下游附近还有滨海湖泊。河流下段旧称萨汉别，上游则称西察。

english:
Nojpetén, “great island” in the Itza language, is a fortified town on an island in Lake Petén Itzá and the capital of the Itza Maya of the Petén basin. Their own histories say the Itza fled south around 1441–1446, after the Xiu overthrew their rule at Mayapan, and settled on the island, dividing the new city into four quarters by lineage. Low walls on the island shore may have been thrown up in haste against Spanish or Maya enemies. The ruler bore the title Aj Kan Ek'.

Cortés, marching to Honduras, crossed Itza country in March 1525 and was received by Kan Ek'; he left behind a lame horse, which the Itza fed flowers and meat and later made a statue of it to worship. The island then went unvisited for nearly a century. Franciscan friars from Yucatán reached it in 1618 and 1619, but the Itza refused to give up their gods. In 1622 the friar Diego Delgado and his Christian Maya were seized and sacrificed. Not until 1695 did Spanish roads again approach Nojpetén. On 13 March 1697 Martín de Ursúa's troops and attack boat stormed the island, the Itza swam to the shore, and the last independent Maya kingdom fell. Ursúa renamed the town Nuestra Señora de los Remedios y San Pablo.
simp_chinese:
诺赫佩滕在伊察语中意为“大岛”，是佩滕伊察湖中一座设防岛城，也是佩滕盆地伊察玛雅人的都城。他们自己的历史说，伊察人在玛雅潘被肖人推翻后，于1441至1446年前后南逃，在岛上定居，并按家族谱系把新城分为四个街区。岛岸的低矮城墙或许是为防西班牙人或其他玛雅人而仓促筑成。统治者的头衔是阿赫·坎·埃克。

科尔特斯在前往洪都拉斯的途中，于1525年3月穿过伊察人的土地，受到坎·埃克接待；他留下一匹跛腿的马，伊察人用鲜花和肉食喂养，后来还为它塑了像，当作神灵。此后近一个世纪没有人造访这座岛。尤卡坦的方济各会修士于1618年和1619年到达，但伊察人拒绝放弃自己的神。1622年，修士迭戈·德尔加多和他带领的基督徒玛雅人被抓获献祭。直到1695年，西班牙的道路才再次通向诺赫佩滕。1697年3月13日，马丁·德·乌尔苏阿的战船与部队攻上岛屿，伊察人泅水逃到岸上，最后一个独立的玛雅王国陷落。乌尔苏阿把这座城改名为“补救圣母与圣保罗”。

english: Nohmul was a Maya city in the lowlands of northern Belize, where large earthworks and public buildings rose above the surrounding settlements. Its history included periods of growth separated by centuries of reduced activity. Population and construction reached important peaks in the late Preclassic and again around the end of the Classic period and beginning of the Postclassic. The city’s changing fortunes show the varied histories of communities across the Maya lowlands.
simp_chinese: 诺穆尔是伯利兹北部低地的一座玛雅城市，大型土台与公共建筑高出周围聚落。其历史经历了数次增长，中间相隔数世纪的活动减少。人口和建筑分别在前古典晚期，以及古典末期至后古典早期达到重要高峰。这座城市的兴衰展现了玛雅低地社群各不相同的历史。

english: Nojima Cape marks the southern tip of the Bōsō Peninsula, where the rocky shore meets the open Pacific. Reefs lie close to the coast, and the current around them can run swiftly. The waters off Shirahama have long offered a livelihood to fishing communities; divers gather shellfish such as abalone and turban shells from the reefs. Beyond the cape the coastline turns north towards the eastern shores of Bōsō.
simp_chinese: 野岛崎是房总半岛的最南端，岩岸在此迎向开阔的太平洋。近岸礁石密布，水流有时十分湍急。白滨附近的海域为渔村提供生计，海女潜入水中，在礁石间采捕鲍鱼和荣螺等贝类。绕过海岬，海岸线便向北延伸，通往房总东岸。

english: The Nokoni were a Comanche band whose range extended from the Cross Timbers of northern Texas toward the mountains of New Mexico. Their name is commonly interpreted as “those who turn back,” reflecting a life of movement across the southern Plains. They shared parts of their territory with the Tenawa and Tanima, smaller Comanche bands. Families hunted bison and moved between grasslands and river valleys, joining or separating as circumstances required.
simp_chinese: 诺科尼人是科曼奇人的一个群体，活动范围从得克萨斯北部的克罗斯廷伯斯林地延伸至新墨西哥的群山。其名称通常解释为“返回的人”，反映了南部平原上的迁徙生活。他们与特纳瓦和塔尼马等较小的科曼奇群体共享部分地域。各家庭猎取野牛，在草原与河谷之间移动，并随需要聚合或分开。

english:
Nakhon Ratchasima, often called Khorat, stands at the western gateway to the plateau that bears its name. Older settlements, including Sema and Khorakhapura, lay to the west, while the fortified city became an important centre of Siamese authority in the northeast. Its walls and moats protected a place commanding routes between the Chao Phraya basin and the interior plateau.

In the seventeenth century King Narai of Ayutthaya ordered a fortified city established here as a frontier stronghold.
